                <p class="p">
                  <ul class="ul"><li class="li">This setting overrides the speaking rate configured in the Flow Designer. </li><li class="li">Extreme values close to the minimum or maximum speaking rate may impact the
                      quality of the generated speech.</li></ul>
                </p>
              </div></div></div></div>
            </div>
              </li></ol>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Configure <strong class="ph b">Custom Vocabulary</strong>. Enter words or phrases separated by commas (up to
          100 words or phrases). Adding custom vocabulary helps the AI agent better recognize and
          respond to specific terms, names, or industry-specific language relevant to your use
          case.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Configure the <strong class="ph b">Delays and interruptions </strong>settings:</p>
            <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Toggle the <strong class="ph b">Allow customer to interrupt </strong>option to enable or disable customers
              speaking over the agent. Enabling this option lets callers interrupt the agent without
              waiting for a pause.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Toggle the <strong class="ph b">Use Webex AI Voice Detection</strong> option to enable or disable a
              smoother barge-in experience for the customer. Enabling this option allows your AI
              agents to detect when a customer starts speaking much sooner. The AI agent stops
              speaking and starts listening with significantly reduced delay. This option is
              applicable for English and other supported languages.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Adjust the <strong class="ph b">End of speech sensitivity </strong>slider to set how quickly the agent
              responds after the caller stops talking. Valid values range from 500 ms (Aggressive)
              to 2000 ms (Relaxed) with a default value of 500 ms (Aggressive).</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the <strong class="ph b">Fulfilment timeout </strong>(in seconds) to set a time limit for task
              execution and to forcibly stop the task. Valid values range from 10 to 30 seconds with
              a default value of 30.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the <strong class="ph b">Caller turn timeout </strong>(in milliseconds) to specify how long the
              system waits before checking if the customer has finished speaking. Valid values range
              from 750 and 3000 milliseconds with a default value of 1500.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the <strong class="ph b">No-input timeout </strong>(in seconds) to set the maximum time to wait for
              customer input before the system assumes no response. Valid values range from 10 to 30
              with a default value of 10.</p>
              </li></ol>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">7</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Configure the<strong class="ph b"> DTMF</strong> settings:</p>
            <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the timeout between two digits (in seconds). This sets how long the AI agent
              waits for the next DTMF input from the customer before proceeding with the
              conversation flow. The default value is 5 seconds. The value can range from 2 to 10
              seconds.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the termination character that the customer can use to indicate the end of
              DTMF input. The termination character can be either <strong class="ph b"># </strong>or <strong class="ph b">*</strong>.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the <strong class="ph b">Max length </strong>(in characters) to set the maximum allowed length for
              DTMF input from customers. The default is 16 characters. The value can range from 8 to
              32 characters.</p>
              </li></ol>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">8</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Save changes</strong>. </p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
          <p class="p">You can preview the conversation experience before you publish the changes, and the
            same conversation settings will apply to the voice preview experience. For more
            information, see  <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_9b45b012-ad0c-4ec7-88e5-75bb5f695d9a" target="" title="">Preview voice
              conversation</a>.</p>
        </div>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">9</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Publish</strong> to make the AI agent live. For more information, see  <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_bed3102a-f6bb-4ded-99d9-8ffb87f3dd9a" target="" title="">Publish your autonomous AI agent</a>.</p>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table></div></article></div></article></div>
  <div><article id="concept-template_b729b9a3-2be8-4818-ac2d-9b3f326d7676" class="topic concept "><h3>Preview your autonomous AI agent</h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p">You can preview the autonomous AI agents at the time of creating the AI agent, while editing,
      and after deploying the agent. </p>
      <p class="p">You can open the preview from:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">AI agent dashboard</strong>—On hovering over an AI agent card, the
            <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> option for that AI agent become visible. Click to open
          the preview of the AI agent.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">AI agent header</strong>— Click on the AI agent card to open the AI agent.
            The <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> option is always visible in the header section.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Minimized widget</strong>—After you launch the preview and minimize it, a chat
          head widget appears at the bottom right of the page. You can use this option to easily
          reopen the preview mode.</li></ul></p>
      
      <section id="section_u5c_25w_1dc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Platform preview widget</h4>
      <p class="p">The preview widget appears on the bottom-right section of the screen. You can provide
        utterances (or a sequence of utterances) to check the AI agent's responses and ensure it’s
        functioning correctly.</p>
      <p class="p">Also, you can minimize the preview widget, provide consumer information, and initiate
        multiple rooms to test the AI agent.</p>
    </section>
    </div><div><article id="concept-template_ebc2af13-75b1-4ef6-8f9d-d8710285f634" class="topic task "><h4>Preview chat conversation</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="section_rlz_ldy_dfc">
      
      <p class="p">The chat preview feature lets you interact with the AI agent as an end user and observe how
        it responds to different queries through text. </p>
      <p class="p">If AI transparency is enabled, preview includes the disclosure experience so you can verify
        the first customer-facing message before you publish the agent.</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the AI agent configuration page, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> in the header.
          The AI agent preview widget appears. </p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
            <p class="p">
              <ul class="ul"><li class="li">If you’ve chosen Webex AI Pro 1.0, you can preview voice conversations in the
                  configured languages. </li><li class="li">If you’ve chosen Webex AI Pro-US 1.0 or Webex AI Pro-Europe 1.0, you can preview
                  voice conversations only in English. </li></ul>
            </p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Start a Chat</span>. The AI agent starts the interaction with its
          welcome message. If AI transparency is enabled, the preview shows the transparency note
          with that first AI-generated message.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Type your query in the text box and press <span class="ph uicontrol">Enter</span>. </p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">You can then see and assess the response from the AI agent. </p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">To start a new chat conversation or session, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> in
          the header.</div>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="task-template_9b45b012-ad0c-4ec7-88e5-75bb5f695d9a" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h4>Preview voice conversation</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      
      <p class="p">The voice preview feature lets you interact with the AI agent as an end user and observe
        how it responds to different queries through voice.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span><p class="p"><ul class="ul"><li class="li"><p class="p">You need browser permissions to preview voice conversations. When prompted by
                  your browser, make sure to click 'Allow' to enable the required access. We
                  recommend using the following browsers:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">Safari on macOS</li><li class="li">Chrome on Windows</li></ul></p></li><li class="li">Use a headset for the best experience. When a caller interrupts the AI agent (via
                barge-in), the AI agent detects the speech, stops the prompt that it is playing, and
                processes the caller's input accordingly—this works optimally only when you are
                using a headset.</li><li class="li">When not using a headset, avoid setting the volume to 100%. </li></ul></p></div></div></div></div></p>
      <p class="p">If AI transparency is enabled, preview includes the disclosure before the welcome message
        so you can verify the voice experience before you publish the agent.</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the AI agent configuration page, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> in the header.

            <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22"           </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Start a call</span>. If AI transparency is enabled, the call
          begins with the transparency note before the welcome message. Callers cannot interrupt the
          transparency note. You can also see the live transcript of the conversation in the
          widget.</p>

  <div><article id="task-template_bed3102a-f6bb-4ded-99d9-8ffb87f3dd9a" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h3>Publish your autonomous AI agent</h3><div id="" class="body taskbody">
      <div class="section prereq p" id=""><div class="tasklabel"><p font-weight="bold" class="sectiontitle tasklabel cB_Bold">Before you begin</p></div>
      <p class="p">Create the autonomous AI agent.</p>
    </div>
      <table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the AI agent configuration page, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Publish</span>.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Publish changes</span> screen, enter the <span class="ph uicontrol">Version name</span> and click <span class="ph uicontrol">Publish</span>.</p>
          <div class="itemgroup info">
          <p class="p">You can view the version details on the <span class="ph uicontrol">History</span> page. For more information, see the  <a data-scope="" href="#section_vby_ttw_1dc" target="" title="">History</a> section.</p>
        </div>
        </td></tr>
      </tbody></table>
    </div></article></div>
  <div><article id="concept-template_e0106832-a025-4a69-ac77-e520c4fb9b9e" class="topic concept "><h3>View autonomous AI agent sessions and history</h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p">You can view the details of sessions established with the customers and the history of the
      configuration changes performed on the AI agent.</p>
      <section id="section_qbv_qtw_1dc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Sessions</h4>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Sessions</span> page provides a comprehensive record of all
        interactions between AI agents and users. To access <span class="ph uicontrol">Sessions</span>:</p>
      <ol class=""><li class="li">
          <p class="p">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Dashboard</span>, click the autonomous AI agent for which you
            want to view the session details.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">From the left navigation pane, click <strong class="ph b">Sessions</strong>. </p>
        </li></ol>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Sessions</span> page appears. Each session is displayed as a record
        that contains all the messages of the session. This information is useful to audit, analyze,
        and improve the AI agent.</p>
      <p class="p">The sessions table shows a list of all the sessions/rooms created for that AI agent. The
        table gets paginated if there are more rows than can be accommodated in one screen. Any of
        the fields in the table can be sorted or filtered using the <span class="ph uicontrol">Refine
          Results</span> section on the left-hand side. The fields represent the following
        information about any particular session:</p>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
          <p class="p">
            <strong class="ph b">Session ID</strong>—The unique room id or session id for a conversation.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">
            <strong class="ph b">Consumer Id</strong>—The id of the consumer who interacted with the AI agent.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">
            <strong class="ph b">Channels</strong>—Channel where the interaction took place.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">
            <strong class="ph b">Updated At</strong>—Time of the room closure.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">
            <strong class="ph b">Room Metadata</strong>—Contains additional information about the room.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">Check the required check boxes:</p>
          <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <span class="ph uicontrol">Hide test sessions</span>—To hide the test sessions and display
                only the list of live sessions.</p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <span class="ph uicontrol">Agent handover happened</span>—To filter the sessions that are
                handed over to an agent. If agent handover happens, it displays the
                  <span class="ph uicontrol">Headphone</span> icon indicating the handover of the chat to a
                human agent.</p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <span class="ph uicontrol">Error occurred</span>—To filter the sessions in which the error
                occurred.</p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <span class="ph uicontrol">Downvoted</span>—To filter the downvoted sessions.</p>
            </li></ul>
          
          
        </li></ul>
    </section>
      <section id="section_cwz_lk3_f2c" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">View session details</h4>
      <p class="p">To view the session details:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><p class="p">Click on an individual row in the sessions table for a detailed view of that session.
              If the session is locked, you need to have permission to decrypt the session.</p></li><li class="li"><p class="p">Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Decrypt content</span> to view the session data.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22"                   conversation. Use the search bar to quickly find a specific conversation
                  transcript. This allows you to navigate lengthy interactions easily without having

13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                    <p class="p">AI Agent transcripts are stored for 90 days before being automatically
                      purged.</p>
                  </div></div></div></div></li><li class="li">Shows the corresponding responses generated by the AI agent.<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><p class="p">The AI agent's <strong class="ph b">barge-in detection</strong> feature identifies instances where
                        a user interrupts or speaks during an ongoing agent utterance. For example,
                        while the AI agent is responding with, "I have checked your account and your
                        balance is...", and the user interrupts with "Okay.", the AI agent detects
                        this user input. Consequently, it immediately stops its current utterance,
                        preventing the full completion of its intended message.</p></li><li class="li">The AI agent response appears with the message bubble, "User interruption
                      detected" in the session transcript, notifying AI agent developers about the
                      specific agent prompt that was interrupted and exact point of
                      interruption.</li><li class="li"><p class="p">The <strong class="ph b">Response interrupted</strong> section in the right panel provides a
                        detailed breakdown of the barge-in event. For example, it displays the
                        complete, intended AI agent response (for example, "I have checked your
                        account and your balance is five thousand dollars."). It also identifies the
                        "Unplayed content" (for example, "five thousand dollars"), explicitly
                        indicating the portion of the AI agent's response that was suppressed or
                        truncated due to the user's real-time interruption.</p><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span><p class="p">Currently, "Unplayed content" is available only for fulfillment
                          responses. It will be extended to general prompts soon.</p></div></div></div></div></li><li class="li">
                      <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Agent closed the session</strong>: The <strong class="ph b">Agent closed the session</strong> event
                        indicates that the AI agent ended the current interaction. It is an
                        informational status and does not, by itself, indicate an error.</p>
                      <p class="p">This event can occur in the following scenarios:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                            <p class="p">If a customer indicated that no further assistance is required by
                              saying “goodbye” or “no, thanks.”</p>
                          </li><li class="li">The AI agent completed the customer’s request and determined that the
                            conversation is finished.</li><li class="li">During a voice interaction, no customer input is detected after three
                            consecutive prompts.</li></ul></p>
                      <p class="p">The customer must start a new interaction if further assistance is
                        needed.</p>
                      <p class="p">If a session closes unexpectedly:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">Review the preceding conversation to determine if the customer
                            indicated that the interaction was complete.</li><li class="li">For voice interactions, check if the customer was silent or if their
                            speech was not detected.</li><li class="li">If the conversation ended before the request was completed, record the
                            session ID, approximate time, and the last messages exchanged. Contact
                            your administrator or Cisco Support.</li></ul></p>
                      <p class="p">The <strong class="ph b">Agent closed the session</strong> event should be interpreted separately
                        from agent handover, which indicates that the interaction was transferred to
                        another agent.</p>
                    </li></ul></li><li class="li">Shows the recording playback modal (along with the session transcript) for
                  conversations between the AI agent and the customer. Recordings are available only
                  for voice sessions, not chat sessions. You can play the recording from the
                  beginning or jump to a specific point. <p class="p">The recording playback modal provides a
                    suite of audio controls:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Play/Pause</strong>: Click <image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477194.png" alt="Play icon" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477194.png" width="" height="" /> to start listening to the interaction session and click <image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477195.png" alt="Pause icon" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477195.png" width="" height="" /> to pause the recording playback. </li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Playback speed</strong>: Click 1X to adjust the audio playback speed,
                        ranging from 0.5X to 2X.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Sound control</strong>: Click <image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477197.png" alt="Sound icon" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477197.png" width="" height="" /> to mute or unmute the sound of the audio during playback. You can also
                        use the volume slider to adjust the playback volume.</li></ul><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 the system enforces enhanced
                            security measures. Depending on the scenario:</p><p class="p"><ul class="ul"><li class="li">If PCI data is detected, the playback modal for the recording is
                                disabled in the session view, preventing access to the audio.</li></ul></p></li><li class="li">When a call is escalated from an AI agent to a human agent, and the
                          human agent then consults back to the same or another AI agent, the
                          recording of the consulted leg is currently not supported. </li></ul></div></div></div></div></p></li><li class="li"><p class="p">For the corresponding response, the right panel displays the <strong class="ph b">Actions
                      performed</strong> section with the following details:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">Agent transfer action</li><li class="li">Slot filling and fulfillment related to all actions</li></ul></p><p class="p">The General information section provides detailed information about each of the
                    actions.</p><p class="p">Use the <strong class="ph b">Expand all</strong> button to expand the transaction. The right panel
                    also displays details about the knowledge utilization with details about
                    document names and files uploaded.</p><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span                     <p class="p">For voice call sessions, the fulfillment output in session details displays
                      only transaction metadata, such as <span class="ph uicontrol">Transaction ID</span> and
                        <span class="ph uicontrol">Size</span>. However, chat preview sessions display the
                      complete fulfillment payload.</p>
                  </div></div></div></div></li></ul></p></li></ul></p>
    </section>
      <section id="section_vby_ttw_1dc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">History</h4>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">History</span> page allows you to view the details of the configuration
        changes performed on the AI agent. To view the history of a specific agent:</p>
      <ol class=""><li class="li">
          <p class="p">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Dashboard</span>, click the autonomous AI agent for which you
            want to view the history.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p">From the left navigation pane, click <span class="ph uicontrol">History</span>.</p>
        </li></ol>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">History</span> page appears with the following tabs:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Version history</span>—Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Version
                History</span> tab to view the various versions of the autonomous AI agent.</p></li><li class="li"><p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Change logs</span>—Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Change Logs</span> tab
              to view the changes made to the AI agents.</p></li></ul></p>
    </section>
      <section id="section_nmr_ktw_1dc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Version history</h4>
      <p class="p">Whenever you publish the autonomous AI agent, a version of the autonomous AI agent is saved
        and is available in the <span class="ph uicontrol">Version history</span> tab. You can view the various
        versions of the AI agent from the <span class="ph uicontrol">Version history</span> tab.</p>
      <p class="p">
        <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
            <p class="p">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">Version description</span>—A brief description about the version of
              the AI agent.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">AI engine</span>—The AI engine used for that version of the AI
              agent.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">Updated at</span>—Date and time when the version was created.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">Actions</span>—Allows you to perform the following actions on the AI
              agent:</p>
            <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                <p class="p">
                  <span class="ph uicontrol">Load as draft</span>—All changes on the AI agent is lost. You
                  must perform the configuration again.</p>
              </li><li class="li">
                <p class="p">
                  <span class="ph uicontrol">Export</span>—Use to export the AI agent.</p>
              </li></ul>
          </li></ul>
      </p>
    </section>
      <section id="section_yhv_gtw_1dc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Change logs</h4>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Change logs</span> tab tracks the changes made to the autonomous AI
        agent. The <span class="ph uicontrol">Change logs</span> tab displays the following details:<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 13.5677 10.9276 13.3928 10.7986 13.2639C10.6697 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
          <p class="p">Users with Admin or AI agent developer roles can only access the <span class="ph uicontrol">Change
              logs</span> tab. Users with custom roles that have the ‘Get Audit log’ permission
            can also view the audit logs.</p>
        </div></div></div></div><ul class="ul"><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Updated at</span>—The date and time of the change.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Updated by</span>—The name of the user who incorporated the
              change.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Change Location</span>—The specific section of the AI agent where the
              change was made.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Description</span>—Additional information about the change.</p>
          </li></ul></p>
      <p class="p">You can search for a specific audit log using the <span class="ph uicontrol">Updated by</span>,
          <span class="ph uicontrol">Change Location</span>, and <span class="ph uicontrol">Description</span> search
        options. You can sort the logs based on the <span class="ph uicontrol">Updated at</span> and
          <span class="ph uicontrol">Updated by</span> fields. </p>
    </section>
    </div></article></div>
  <div><article id="concept-template_3e7d5e05-f8d3-4d40-bd41-a79b131b35c6" class="topic concept "><h3>View Autonomous AI agent performance using analytics</h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p"> The AI agent analytics section provides a graphical representation of the key metrics to
      evaluate the AI agent performance and effectiveness. To generate the analytics of the
      Autonomous AI agent:</p>
      <p class="p">
      <ol class=""><li class="li">Choose the AI agent from the <span class="ph uicontrol">Dashboard</span>.</li><li class="li">On the left navigation pane, click <strong class="ph b">Analytics</strong>. An overview of the AI agent
          performance appears in both tabular format and graphical representation.</li></ol>
    </p>
      <p class="p">The first section displays the following statistics about sessions and messages for the AI
      agent.</p>
      <ul class="ul">
        <li class="li">Total sessions and sessions handled by the AI agent without human intervention.</li>
        <li class="li">Total agent handovers, which is a count of number of sessions handed over to human
        agents.</li>
        <li class="li">Daily average sessions.</li>
        <li class="li">Total messages (human and AI agent messages) and how many of those messages came from
        users.</li>
        <li class="li">Daily average messages.</li>
      </ul>
      <p class="p">The second section displays the statistics about the users. It provides a count of total
      users and information about average sessions per user and daily average users.</p>
      <p class="p">The third section displays the AI agent responses and agent handovers.</p>
    </div></article></div>
</article>
  </main>
</div>

  <div><article id="concept-template_4777d368-bcf4-4e97-9b5d-9eb0db6b6393" class="topic concept "><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p">Scripted AI agents enhance the no-code agent-building capabilities of the Webex AI Agent Studio platform. They enable multiturn conversations, gathering relevant data from customers to
      perform specific tasks. This includes: </p>
      <ul class="ul">
        <li class="li">
        <p class="p">Running simple commands—Follow instructions to complete predefined actions.</p>
      </li>
        <li class="li">
        <p class="p">Processing data—Manipulate and transform data according to specified rules.</p>
      </li>
        <li class="li">
        <p class="p">Interacting with other systems—Communicate with and control other solutions.</p>
      </li>
      </ul>
      <p class="p">Scripted AI agents are knowledge-driven agents whose knowledge base consists of a corpus of
      questions and answers. Scripted AI agent can provide answers based on a user-created training
      corpus, which is a collection of examples and answers. This capability is useful in scenarios
      where: </p>
      <ul class="ul">
        <li class="li">
        <p class="p">Specific knowledge is required—The agent needs to answer questions within a predefined
          domain. </p>
      </li>
        <li class="li">
        <p class="p">Consistency is important—The agent must provide consistent responses to similar queries.
        </p>
      </li>
        <li class="li">
        <p class="p">Limited flexibility is needed—The agent's responses are constrained by the information in
          the training corpus.</p>
      </li>
      </ul>
      <p class="p">
      <?oxy-placeholder content="Paragraph"?>
    </p>
    </div></article></div>
  <div><article id="task-template_72a02c77-a182-4301-b588-235a042809a2" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h3>Create a scripted AI agent</h3><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
        <div class="video-wrapper"><video controls="controls" autoplay="autoplay" loop="loop" muted="muted" src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/488001-489000/488649.mp4" poster="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/488001-489000/488648.jpg" width="100%"></video></div>
      </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Log in to the Webex AI Agent Studio platform.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the dashboard, click <span class="ph uicontrol">+ Create agent</span>.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Create an AI Agent</span> screen, choose <span class="ph uicontrol">Start from
            scratch</span> and click <span class="ph uicontrol">Next</span>. </p>
          <div class="itemgroup info">

fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
            <p class="p">You can also choose a predefined template to create your AI agent quickly. You can
              filter the AI agent type to <code class="ph codeph">Scripted</code>. In this case, the fields on the
                <span class="ph uicontrol">Profile</span> page autopopulate. For more information on the
              templates, see  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n8mo4c/" target="_blank" title="">Use AI agent templates</a>.</p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose <span class="ph uicontrol">Scripted</span> agent type.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Specify the following details:</p>
          <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                <span class="ph uicontrol">Agent name</span>—Enter the name of the AI agent.</p>
            </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                <span class="ph uicontrol">System ID</span>—A system-generated unique identifier. This field
              is editable.</p>
            </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                <span class="ph uicontrol">AI engine</span>—Choose an AI engine from the drop-down list. The
              available options are:</p>
              <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ul class="ul"><li class="li">Webex AI Agent Pro 2.0 (with Swiftmatch)—this is the default option.</li><li class="li">Webex AI Agent Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch)</li></ul>
              <p class="p">For details about each AI engine's capabilities, refer to the  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/article/ne6s80cb" target="_blank" title="">Understand AI engines for AI agents</a> article.</p>
            </div>
            </li></ol>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Create</span>. You have now successfully created the scripted AI
          agent which is now available on the <span class="ph uicontrol">Dashboard</span>.</p>
          <div class="itemgroup info">

          </div></div></div></div>

  <div><article id="concept-template_48f88bed-db0d-4b55-8fcf-a0435deec60a" class="topic concept "><h3>Configure scripted AI agent</h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p">The following sections guide you on how to configure scripted AI agent for your specific
      needs:</p>
      <p class="p">
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_c7edf167-b532-4222-b464-d54ad1d8b893" target="" title="">Update scripted AI agent profile</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#concept-template_48a58175-b53a-49e7-afd8-70d950c50bc1" target="" title="">Configure scripts</a></p>
          <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
              <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_6361ba29-ee9e-4b62-b9b5-b80cfe6652e7" target="" title="">Create an intent</a></p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_5e5dea5a-2b74-4883-a52f-8b70e07671b7" target="" title="">Create an entity</a></p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_336f85da-d3db-4427-b942-d5821752e630" target="" title="">Create a response</a></p>
            </li></ul>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_d3113eca-9043-44af-a1ba-493fc6f90af8" target="" title="">Configure agent handover</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_f628b019-be9c-483e-92ea-b870a6b51a50" target="" title="">Configure language and voice</a></p>
        </li></ul>
    </p>
    </div><div><article id="task-template_c7edf167-b532-4222-b464-d54ad1d8b893" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h4>Update scripted AI agent profile</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="context_ckk_t2s_zcc">
      
      <p class="p">Use the <span class="ph uicontrol">Profile</span> tab to manage the customer-facing disclosure that
        tells customers when they are interacting with an AI agent.</p>
    </section><div class="section prereq p" id="prereq_bkk_t2s_zcc"><div class="tasklabel"><p font-weight="bold" class="sectiontitle tasklabel cB_Bold">Before you begin</p></div>
      <p class="p">Create a scripted AI agent.</p>
    </div><table class="stepTable" id="steps_dkk_t2s_zcc" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Dashboard</span>, click the AI agent that you've created.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to the <span class="menucascade"><span class="ph uicontrol">Configurations</span> &gt; <span class="ph uicontrol"> Profile</span></span> tab and configure the following details:</p>
            <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">Agent name</span>—Edit the name of the AI agent, if needed.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">System ID</span>—Edit the system id of the AI agent, if
              needed.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">URL for agent profile image</span>—The default URL from where the
              system fetches the AI agent's logo or image. Change this if needed.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">Time zone</span>—Choose your time zone from the drop-down list.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">Allow feedback</span>—Enable this toggle to let an AI agent ask for
              feedback in the message.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">AI engine</span>—Displays the chosen AI engine. You can update the AI
              engine by clicking the icon next to the drop-down list. For more information, see
                 <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_6df54695-7d89-4046-b0c1-3648dfec3067" target="" title="">Update AI engine settings</a>.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">Description</span>—Enter the details about the AI agent.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">Custom error message</span>—Enter a custom error message for server or
              proxy errors.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
              <span class="ph uicontrol">AI transparency</span>—Enable or disable the transparency note that
              tells customers they are interacting with an AI agent. Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Edit
                transparency disclosure</span> to edit the default transparency message.</p>
                <div class="itemgroup info">
              <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 6.1875V15.8125C2.75107 16.7239 3.11358 17.5976 3.75801 18.242C4.40243 18.8864 5.27615 19.2489 6.1875 19.25H15.8125C16.7239 19.2489 17.5976 18.8864 18.242 18.242C18.8864 17.5976 19.2489 16.7239 19.25 17.8744 15.8125 17.875H6.1875C5.64068 17.8744 5.11642 17.6569 4.72976 17.2702C4.34309 16.8836 4.1256 16.3593 4.125 15.8125V6.1875C4.1256 5.64068 4.34309 5.11642 4.72976 4.72976C5.11642 4.34309 5.64068 4.1256 6.1875 4.125H15.8125C16.3593 4.1256 16.8836 4.34309 17.2702 4.72976C17.6569 5.11642 17.8744 5.64068 17.875 6.1875V15.8125Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path d="M15.125 6.1875H6.875C6.69266 6.1875 6.5178 9.625H6.875C6.69266 9.625 6.5178 9.69743 6.38886 9.82636C6.25993 9.9553 6.1875 10.1302 6.1875 10.3125C6.1875 10.4948 6.25993 10.6697 6.38886 10.7986C6.5178 10.9276 6.69266 11 6.875 11H15.125C15.3073 11 15.4822 10.9276 15.6111 10.7986C15.7401 10.6697 15.8125 10.4948 15.8125 10.3125C15.8125 10.1302 15.7401 9.9553 15.6111 9.82636C15.4822 9.69743 15.3073 9.625 15.125 9.625Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path 14.4375H10.3125C10.4948 14.4375 10.6697 14.3651 10.7986 14.2361C10.9276 14.1072 11 13.9323 11 13.75C11 13.5677 10.9276 13.3928 10.7986 13.2639C10.6697 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                <ul class="ul"><li class="li">The default transparency note is used when a language-specific message is
                    unavailable.</li><li class="li">For digital conversations, the transparency note is added to the first
                    AI-generated response in the session.</li><li class="li">For voice conversations, the transparency note plays before the AI interaction
                    continues and callers cannot interrupt it.</li><li class="li">New AI agents have AI transparency enabled by default. If you turn it off,
                    acknowledge the warning and provide a reason.</li></ul>
              </div></div></div></div>
            </div>
              </li></ol>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Save changes</span>.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Publish</span> to make the AI agent live.</p>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table></div><div><article id="task-template_6df54695-7d89-4046-b0c1-3648dfec3067" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h5>
          <strong class="ph b">Update AI engine settings</strong>
        </h5><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">Scripted AI agents use AI engines (powered by machine learning) to understand and respond
        to customer queries. Here's a quick overview of the AI engines used: <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 2.0 (with Swiftmatch)</strong>—An advanced generative AI-powered NLU
              engine that delivers high-precision intent recognition. It features adaptive learning
              for better generalization, reducing the need for extensive manual training
              examples.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch)</strong>—A fast and lightweight training engine that
              supports multiple languages.</p>
          </li></ul></p>
      <p class="p">To change the AI engine for the AI agent:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Dashboard</span>, click the AI agent that you've created.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to <span class="menucascade"><span class="ph uicontrol">Configurations</span> &gt; <span class="ph uicontrol">Profile</span></span> tab.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click the icon next to the AI engine.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">In the <span class="ph uicontrol">Manage AI Engine</span> page, configure the following
          fields:</p>
              <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <span class="ph uicontrol">Training Engine</span>—Choose the required AI engine from the
              drop-down list. </p>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 6.1875V15.8125C2.75107 16.7239 3.11358 17.5976 3.75801 18.242C4.40243 18.8864 5.27615 19.2489 6.1875 19.25H15.8125C16.7239 19.2489 17.5976 18.8864 18.242 18.242C18.8864 17.5976 19.2489 16.7239 19.25 15.8125V6.1875C19.2489 5.27615 18.8864 4.40243 18.242 3.75801C17.5976 3.11358 16.7239 2.75107 15.8125 2.75ZM17.875 15.8125C17.8744 16.3593 17.6569 16.8836 17.2702 17.2702C16.8836 17.6569 16.3593 17.8744 15.8125 17.875H6.1875C5.64068 17.8744 5.11642 17.6569 4.72976 17.2702C4.34309 16.8836 4.1256 16.3593 4.125 15.8125V6.1875C4.1256 5.64068 4.34309 5.11642 4.72976 4.72976C5.11642 4.34309 5.64068 4.1256 6.1875 4.125H15.8125C16.3593 4.1256 16.8836 4.34309 17.2702 4.72976C17.6569 5.11642 17.8744 5.64068 17.875 6.1875V15.8125Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path d="M15.125 6.1875H6.875C6.69266 6.1875 6.5178 6.25993 6.38886 6.38886C6.25993 6.5178 6.1875 6.69266 6.1875 6.875C6.1875 7.05734 6.25993 7.2322 6.38886 7.36114C6.5178 7.49007 6.69266 7.5625 6.875 7.5625H15.125C15.3073 7.5625 15.4822 7.49007 15.6111 7.36114C15.7401 7.2322 15.8125 7.05734 15.8125 6.875C15.8125 6.69266 15.7401 6.5178 15.6111 6.38886C15.4822 6.25993 15.3073 6.1875 15.125 6.1875Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path d="M15.125 9.625H6.875C6.69266 9.625 6.5178 9.69743 6.38886 9.82636C6.25993 9.9553 6.1875 10.1302 6.1875 10.3125C6.1875 10.4948 6.25993 10.6697 6.38886 10.7986C6.5178 10.9276 6.69266 11 6.875 11H15.125C15.3073 11 15.4822 10.9276 15.6111 10.7986C15.7401 10.6697 15.8125 10.4948 15.8125 10.3125C15.8125 10.1302 15.7401 9.9553 15.6111 9.82636C15.4822 9.69743 15.3073 9.625 15.125 9.625Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path 14.4375H10.3125C10.4948 14.4375 10.6697 14.3651 10.7986 14.2361C10.9276 14.1072 11 13.9323 11 13.75C11 13.5677 10.9276 13.3928 10.7986 13.2639C10.6697 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                <p class="p">Training an AI agent using Webex AI Pro 2.0 (with Swiftmatch) model may take
                  slightly longer than Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch) model.</p>
              </div></div></div></div>
            </div>
                </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <span class="ph uicontrol">Inference</span>—Specify the following information:</p>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Score below which fallback is shown</span>—The minimum
                    confidence needed to display a response, below which a fallback response
                    appears. Note that switching your AI engine will change the default value of
                    this setting. </p>
                  <table width="100%" border="1"><caption><span class="table--title-label table title">Table 1. </span><span class="tabletitle">Fallback score values for AI engines</span></caption><thead><tr><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">AI Engine</th><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">Range of Values</th><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">Default Value</th><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">Input method</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td headers="" align=""><strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 2.0 (with Swiftmatch)</strong></td><td headers="" align="">-0.1, -0.05, 0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2 </td><td headers="" align="">0.05</td><td headers="" align="">Choose a predefined value from the drop-down list. </td></tr><tr><td headers="" align=""><strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch)</strong></td><td headers="" align="">0 to 1</td><td headers="" align="">0.3</td><td headers="" align="">Enter a valid value in the text box.</td></tr></tbody></table>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Difference in score for partial match</span>—The minimum gap
                    between confidence levels of responses to clearly display the best match below
                    which a partial match template is shown. Note that switching your AI engine will
                    change the default value of this setting. For both engines, the score is 0
                    -1.</p>
                  <table width="100%" border="1"><caption><span class="table--title-label table title">Table 2. </span><span class="tabletitle">Partial match score values for AI engines</span></caption><thead><tr><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">AI Engine</th><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">Range of Values</th><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">Default Value</th><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">Input method</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td headers="" align=""><strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 2.0 (with Swiftmatch)</strong></td><td headers="" align="">0—1</td><td headers="" align="">0.02</td><td headers="" align="">Enter a valid value in the text box.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align=""><strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch)</strong></td><td headers="" align="">0—1</td><td headers="" align="">0.05</td><td headers="" align="">Enter a valid value in the text box.</td></tr></tbody></table>
                  <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 6.1875V15.8125C2.75107 16.7239 3.11358 17.5976 3.75801 18.242C4.40243 18.8864 5.27615 19.2489 6.1875 19.25H15.8125C16.7239 19.2489 17.5976 18.8864 18.242 18.242C18.8864 17.5976 19.2489 16.7239 19.25 15.8125V6.1875C19.2489 5.27615 18.8864 4.40243 18.242 3.75801C17.5976 3.11358 16.7239 2.75107 15.8125 2.75ZM17.875 15.8125C17.8744 16.3593 17.6569 16.8836 17.2702 17.2702C16.8836 17.6569 16.3593 17.8744 15.8125 17.875H6.1875C5.64068 17.8744 5.11642 17.6569 4.72976 17.2702C4.34309 16.8836 4.1256 16.3593 4.125 15.8125V6.1875C4.1256 5.64068 4.34309 5.11642 4.72976 4.72976C5.11642 4.34309 5.64068 4.1256 6.1875 4.125H15.8125C16.3593 4.1256 16.8836 4.34309 17.2702 4.72976C17.6569 5.11642 17.8744 5.64068 17.875 6.1875V15.8125Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path d="M15.125 6.1875H6.875C6.69266 6.1875 6.5178 6.25993 6.38886 6.38886C6.25993 6.5178 6.1875 6.69266 6.1875 6.875C6.1875 7.05734 6.25993 7.2322 6.38886 7.36114C6.5178 7.49007 6.69266 7.5625 6.875 7.5625H15.125C15.3073 7.5625 15.4822 7.49007 15.6111 7.36114C15.7401 7.2322 15.8125 7.05734 15.8125 6.875C15.8125 6.69266 15.7401 6.5178 15.6111 6.38886C15.4822 6.25993 15.3073 6.1875 15.125 6.1875Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path d="M15.125 9.625H6.875C6.69266 9.625 6.5178 9.69743 6.38886 9.82636C6.25993 9.9553 6.1875 10.1302 6.1875 10.3125C6.1875 10.4948 6.25993 10.6697 6.38886 10.7986C6.5178 10.9276 6.69266 11 6.875 11H15.125C15.3073 11 15.4822 10.9276 15.6111 10.7986C15.7401 10.6697 15.8125 10.4948 15.8125 10.3125C15.8125 10.1302 15.7401 9.9553 15.6111 9.82636C15.4822 9.69743 15.3073 9.625 15.125 9.625Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path d="M10.3125 13.0625H6.875C6.69266 13.0625 6.5178 13.1349 6.38886 13.2639C6.25993 13.3928 6.1875 13.5677 6.1875 13.75C6.1875 13.9323 6.25993 14.1072 6.38886 14.2361C6.5178 14.3651 6.69266 14.4375 6.875 14.4375H10.3125C10.4948 14.4375 10.6697 14.3651 10.7986 14.2361C10.9276 14.1072 11 13.9323 11 13.75C11 13.5677 10.9276 13.3928 10.7986 13.2639C10.6697 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                    <p class="p">In most cases, the default threshold value is sufficient. For use cases that
                      require customization, validate alternative fallback threshold values using
                      the testing functionality and choose the range that performs best based on the
                      samples added.</p>
                  </div></div></div></div>
                  <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 2.0 (with Swiftmatch)</strong> uses two scores: a Similarity score
                    and a Partial Match score to determine intent matches. An intent is considered a
                    match if its score is above 0.05. <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                        <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Partial Match</strong>: If two or more intents have scores above 0.05, and
                          the difference between their scores is less than or equal to 0.02, the AI
                          agent triggers a partial match and asks the user to clarify between the
                          options.</p>
                      </li><li class="li">
                        <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Confident Match</strong>: If the difference between the top two intent
                          scores is greater than 0.02, the system identifies the highest-scoring
                          intent as the potential match.</p>
                      </li></ul></p>
                </li></ul>
            </div>
                </li></ol>
              <div class="itemgroup info">
          <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
              <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Advanced Settings</span>—Specify the following information:</p>
              <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Expand contractions</span>—Check this option to convert
                    contractions in training data and consumer queries into their full forms for
                    better accuracy. This option is available for Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with
                    Swiftmatch).</p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Spellcheck in inference</span>—Check this option to identify
                    and fix the spelling mistakes before processing the text. This option is
                    available for all three AI engines.</p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Prioritize slot filling</span>—Check this option to prioritize
                    slot filling over intent detection. This option is available for Webex AI Pro
                    1.0 (with Swiftmatch).</p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Results stored per message</span>—Enter the number of
                    transactions (for which the AI agent has calculated confidence scores) to list
                    under Transaction information in the Sessions. This option is available for all
                    three AI engines. </p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Multi-lingual model</span>—Choose the model from the drop-down
                    list to enable the multilingual inference. Configure more than one language for
                    an AI agent to enable this option and this option is available only for Webex AI
                    Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch).</p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Vector model</span>—Choose the vector model from the drop-down
                    list to improve the accuracy of the AI agent. This feature is only available for
                    Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch).</p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Remove stopwords</span>—Check this option to remove the
                    stopwords during training and inference. This feature is only available for
                    Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch). </p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Remove special characters</span>—Check this option to remove
                    special characters from customer queries for better responses. This option is
                    available only for Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch).</p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Replace entities in inference</span>—Check this option to
                    replace entity values in training data and inference with entity IDs. This
                    option is available only for Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with Swiftmatch). </p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Wordform expansion</span>—Check this option to expand training
                    data with wordforms (such as plurals, verbs, and so on), along with the synonyms
                    present in the data. This option is available only for Webex AI Pro 1.0 (with
                    Swiftmatch). </p>
                </li></ul>
            </li></ul>
        </div>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Update</span> to change the AI engine settings for the AI
          agent.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Save changes</span> to update the AI engine settings.</p>
            </td></tr>
          </tbody></table></div></article></div></article></div><div><article id="concept-template_48a58175-b53a-49e7-afd8-70d950c50bc1" class="topic concept "><h4>Configure scripts</h4><div id="" class="body conbody">
        <p class="p">Scripts are the building blocks that power your AI agent's understanding and responses. This
      section describes three key components: <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
          <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Intents</strong> capture the various goals or actions users want to accomplish when
            interacting with your AI agent. Mapping user intents enables the AI agent to recognize
            and respond appropriately to user requests. To create an intent, see  <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_6361ba29-ee9e-4b62-b9b5-b80cfe6652e7" target="" title="">Create an intent</a>.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Entities</strong> are the specific pieces of information your AI agent needs to extract
            from user inputs. These include dates, product names, or custom values unique to the
            customer use case. Entities are important variables that your AI agent must understand
            to fulfill the user requests effectively. To create an entity, see  <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_5e5dea5a-2b74-4883-a52f-8b70e07671b7" target="" title="">Create an entity</a>.</p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Responses</strong> are your AI agent's carefully crafted replies to user requests. They
            dictate how your AI agent communicates with the users after understanding their intent
            and gathering the necessary entities. To create a response, see  <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_336f85da-d3db-4427-b942-d5821752e630" target="" title="">Create a response</a>.</p>
        </li></ul></p>
        <p class="p">Together, these components work together to create fluid and purposeful conversations between
      your agent and its users. For more information, see  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/sz02k8/Understand-intents,-entities,-and-responses-in-AI-Agent-Studio" target="_blank" title="">Understand intents, entities, and responses in AI Agent
        Studio</a>.</p>
      </div><div><article id="task-template_6361ba29-ee9e-4b62-b9b5-b80cfe6652e7" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h5>
          <strong class="ph b">Create an intent</strong>
        </h5><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="" /><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <strong class="ph b">Dashboard</strong>, click the AI agent that you've created.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to <span class="ph uicontrol">Configurations &gt; Scripts &gt; Intents</span>.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">+Create intent</span>.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Add a new intent</span> screen, specify the following
          details:</p>
              <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <strong class="ph b">Intent name</strong>—Enter a name for the intent.</p>
                </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <strong class="ph b">Intent description</strong>—Enter a clear and concise description for the intent. To
              optimize AI agent performance, provide a descriptive phrase rather than just one or
              two words. This field is mandatory and applicable only to the <strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 2.0
                (Swiftmatch)</strong> engine. If you switch from <strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 1.0 (Swiftmatch)</strong>
              engine to <strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 2.0 (Swiftmatch)</strong> engine, you must provide a description
              to resolve any validation error.</p>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                <p class="p">If harmful content is detected in the intent description, a generic warning will
                  appear, and you can't save the changes until the content is removed or
                  corrected.</p>
              </div></div></div></div>
            </div>
                </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <span class="ph uicontrol">Settings</span>—Toggle on and off the following settings for the
              intent:</p>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ol class=""><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Reset slots after completion</span>—Toggle on to reset the slot
                  values collected in the conversation once the intent is complete. If this toggle
                  is in disabled status, the slot retains the old values and displays the same
                  response.</li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">End conversation</span>—Toggle on to close the session after
                  this intent. Webex Connect and voice flows can use this to close a conversation
                  with customers.</li></ol>
            </div>
                </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <span class="ph uicontrol">Context</span>—Provide the entry and exit contexts for the intent.
              For more information, see  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/article/sz02k8#concept-template_b150cc96-f8db-484d-8cd5-e7cbbef3bb24" target="_blank" title="">Contexts</a>.</p>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ul class="ul"><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Entry context</span>—Enter the required input in the text box
                  and press the Enter or Return key to add the entry context. You can configure a
                  maximum of 5 entry contexts for a particular intent. <p class="p">Entry contexts control
                    whether an intent can be matched with the customer query based on the active
                    context of the session.</p></li><li class="li"><span class="ph uicontrol">Exit context</span>—Enter the required input in the text box and
                  press the Enter or Return key to add the exit context. You can configure a maximum
                  of 15 exit contexts for a particular intent. <p class="p">Exit contexts control the active
                    contexts for a session.</p></li></ul>
            </div>
                </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <span class="ph uicontrol">Intent &amp; utterances</span>—Add an utterance or a phrase to
              determine the intent and click <span class="ph uicontrol">+Add</span>.</p>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <p class="p">For voice-channel DTMF choices that trigger scripted intents, add the keypad digit
                as an utterance for the matching intent. For example, if the prompt says “Press 1
                for billing, press 2 for support,” add 1 as an utterance to the Billing intent and 2
                as an utterance to the Support intent.</p>
            </div>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 2.0 (Swiftmatch)</strong> engine requires at least<code class="ph codeph"> 10
                    utterances</code> per intent. This number is calculated across all configured
                  languages within the intent. When switching from <strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 1.0
                    (Swiftmatch)</strong> engine to <strong class="ph b">Webex AI Pro 2.0 (Swiftmatch)</strong> engine, you must
                  meet this 10-utterance minimum to resolve validation error.</p>
                <p class="p">If any harmful content is detected in the utterances, a generic warning will
                  appear, and you can't save the changes until the content is removed or
                  corrected.</p>
              </div></div></div></div>
            </div>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Generate variants</strong>—For the system to generate utterances automatically
                  based on the intent, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Generate variants</span>. <ol class=""><li class="li">In the <span class="ph uicontrol">Generate variants</span> dialog box, provide a
                      description of your intent to generate relevant training data or utterances. </li><li class="li">Enter the number of variants to be generated and choose how creative you
                      want the underlying LLM to be while generating these variants.</li><li class="li">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Generate</span>.</li></ol>
                </li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Add entities as slots</strong>—If any entities are present in the added
                  utterances, they are auto annotated in the utterances and appear in the
                    <span class="ph uicontrol">Slots</span> section. You can select the part of the utterance
                  as a slot for that intent and choose an already created entity or create a new
                  entity.</li></ul>
            </div>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22"
