fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                <p class="p">The intent requires at least 3 utterances and 2 slot annotations for training
                  with the current AI engine.</p>
              </div></div></div></div>
            </div>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">Each slot displays the following:</div>
                </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <span class="ph uicontrol">Slots (optional)</span>—Link the entities for the slot filling.
              This ensures that the AI agent gathers all the required information. </p>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ol class=""><li class="li">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">+Link</span> to link an entity to the intent. If there’s
                  no entity in the list, the <span class="ph uicontrol">+Link</span> option doesn’t appear. To
                  create an entity, see the  <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_5e5dea5a-2b74-4883-a52f-8b70e07671b7" target="" title="">Create an entity</a> section. The following slot details appear and you can
                  configure the retries and response for the required slot:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">The linked entity name.</li><li class="li">Required—Check the check box to determine whether it’s required for intent
                      completion. </li><li class="li">Retries—Enter the number of retries the AI agent attempts to get this slot
                      value from the customer. </li><li class="li">Response—Choose the response for the slot from the drop-down list. To create
                      a new custom response, click <span class="ph uicontrol">+Create new</span>.</li></ul></li><li class="li">Configure the following <span class="ph uicontrol">Settings</span>:<ol class=""><li class="li">
                      <p class="p">Toggle the <span class="ph uicontrol">Update slot values</span> on to update the slot
                        value during the conversation with the customer.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span                           <p class="p">The AI agent considers the last value filled in the slot to process the
                            data. If you enable this feature, the system updates values for filled
                            slots whenever customers provide new information for the same slot
                            type.</p>
                        </div></div></div></div></p>
                    </li><li class="li">Toggle the <span class="ph uicontrol">Provide suggestions for slots</span> on to
                      provide suggestions for slot filling and alternate slot values in the final
                      response, based on customer input. </li></ol></li></ol>
            </div>
                </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <span class="ph uicontrol">Response</span>—In the <span class="ph uicontrol">Response</span> section,
              choose the response that you want to return to customers on completion of the intent.
              Once chosen, click <strong class="ph b">View the content of selected response</strong> to view the response
              content. To add a new custom response, click <span class="ph uicontrol">+Create new</span> to
              create a new response. For more information, see  <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_336f85da-d3db-4427-b942-d5821752e630" target="" title="">Create a response</a>.</p>
                </li></ol>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Add</span> to create an intent.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Publish</span> to make the AI agent live.</p>
            </td></tr>
          </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="task-template_5e5dea5a-2b74-4883-a52f-8b70e07671b7" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h5>
          <strong class="ph b">Create an entity</strong>
        </h5><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="" /><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <strong class="ph b">Dashboard</strong>, click the AI agent that you've created.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to <span class="ph uicontrol">Configurations &gt; Scripts &gt; Entities</span>.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click<span class="ph uicontrol">+Create entity</span>.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Create entity</span> window, specify the following fields:</p>
              <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <strong class="ph b">Entity name</strong>—Enter the entity name.</p>
                </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                  <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                    <strong class="ph b">Entity type</strong>—Choose an entity type from the drop-down list. Based on the
              chosen entity type, enter a value in the additional field, if it appears.</p>
                  <div class="itemgroup info">
              <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                <p class="p">
                  <ul class="ul"><li class="li">If the AI agent has difficulty identifying a person's name with the
                        <code class="ph codeph">Person names</code> entity type, try using the <code class="ph codeph">Free
                        form</code> entity type for improved recognition.</li><li class="li">If the AI Agent doesn’t recognize inputs as expected when using
                        <code class="ph codeph">Regex</code> or <code class="ph codeph">Alphanumeric</code> entity value with
                      spaces in the character class (for example, <code class="ph codeph">^[a-zA-Z 0-9]+$</code>),
                      try using the <code class="ph codeph">Free Form</code> entity type for broader matching. If
                      you prefer to use <code class="ph codeph">Regex</code> or <code class="ph codeph">Alphanumeric</code>
                      entity values with spaces, you can uncheck the "Replace entities in inference"
                      option in the advanced engine settings.</li></ul>
                </p>
              </div></div></div></div>
            </div>
                </li></ol>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Save changes</span>.</p>
              <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
            <p class="p">You can use <span class="ph uicontrol">Edit</span> and <span class="ph uicontrol">Delete</span> options in
              the <span class="ph uicontrol">Actions</span> column to perform related actions. You can edit
              only the entity name and not the entity type.</p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
            </td></tr>
          </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="task-template_336f85da-d3db-4427-b942-d5821752e630" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h5>
          <strong class="ph b">Create a response</strong>
        </h5><div id="" class="body taskbody">
          <table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <strong class="ph b">Dashboard</strong>, click the AI agent that you've created.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to <span class="menucascade"><span class="ph uicontrol">Configurations</span> &gt; <span class="ph uicontrol">Scripts</span> &gt; <span class="ph uicontrol">Responses</span></span>.</p>
              <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 9.625H6.875C6.69266 9.625 6.5178 9.69743 6.38886 9.82636C6.25993 9.9553 6.1875 10.1302 6.1875 10.3125C6.1875 10.4948 6.25993 10.6697 6.38886 10.7986C6.5178 10.9276 6.69266 11 6.875 11H15.125C15.3073 fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
            <p class="p">The system provides default conditional responses for Web channel which you can use
              for customer interactions. If AI transparency is enabled, the default AI transparency
              response appears in the list. You can use the <span class="ph uicontrol">Edit</span> icon in each
              response to modify the response settings. You can't delete the default responses and
              Web channel.</p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">To create a custom response, click <span class="ph uicontrol">+Add response</span>.</p>
              <div class="itemgroup stepresult">
                <span class="ph uicontrol">Add a new response</span> screen appears.</div>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Add a new response</span> screen, enter the new
            <span class="ph uicontrol">Response name</span>.</p>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">For the configured language, you can optionally add a conditional response by clicking
            <span class="ph uicontrol">Add condition</span>. </p>
              <div class="itemgroup info">
          <ol class=""><li class="li">
              <p class="p">Enter the condition name and click <span class="ph uicontrol">Create</span>.</p>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p">Click the condition and go to the <span class="ph uicontrol">Rules</span> section, provide the
                IF and OR variable conditions, as needed.</p>
              <ol class=""><li class="li">In the <strong class="ph b">Left variable </strong>field, choose the response variable from the
                  drop-down list. For more information about response variables, see the  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/sz02k8/Understand-intents,-entities,-and-responses-in-AI-Agent-Studio#concept-template_352cad79-2ed2-433b-a37d-658b8e003604" target="_blank" title="">List of common response variables</a> table.
                  This table contains the list of variables that you can use in this field to define
                  rules. These variables can also be used to customize AI agent responses.</li><li class="li">Choose the appropriate operator to execute the rule.</li><li class="li">Choose the data type from the drop-down list. Data types are populated based on
                  the chosen operator.</li><li class="li">In the <strong class="ph b">Right variable </strong>field, specify the response variable. The type of
                  variable value with which the syntax in the left variable must match. This field
                  is displayed only when you set the Operator to any of these values—Equals to, Not
                  Equals to, In, Greater than, Less than. You can also use the list of variables to
                  define rules in the right variable of the conditional response type if you set the
                    <code class="ph codeph">Data type </code> to <code class="ph codeph">Variable</code>.</li></ol>
            </li><li class="li">
              <p class="p">Click <strong class="ph b">Actions</strong> to create a response for the defined rule. In the
                  <span class="ph uicontrol">Actions</span> section, you can configure the response to be
                displayed for the customer query once the rule is fulfilled.<ul class="ul"><li class="li">To add a response for Web (default) channel:<ol class=""><li class="li">Choose the response type from the right pane. The supported response types
                        are Text, Carousel, Quick Reply, Image, Video, Audio, and File.</li><li class="li">For the chosen response type, configure the required settings. For
                        information on how to configure various responses for Web (default), see the
                           <a data-scope="" href="#concept-template_86a220a2-df7a-4973-be7b-fa58dba3dce7" target="" title="">Configure
                          response types</a> section.</li></ol></li></ul><ul class="ul"><li class="li">To add a response for the other channels:<ol class=""><li class="li">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">+</span> next to Web (default).</li><li class="li">Choose the desired channel from the drop-down list. The supported channels
                        are Messenger, SMS, WhatsApp, Apple Messages for Business, RCS, and Voice. </li><li class="li">Choose the response type for the chosen channel from the right pane. For
                        supported response types for various channels, see the  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/article/sz02k8/Understand-intents,-entities,-and-responses-in-AI-Agent-Studio#section_xrr_w2k_g2c" target="_blank" title="">Supported response types for
                          channels</a> section.</li><li class="li">Configure the required settings for the chosen response type. For
                        information on how to configure various responses, see the  <a data-scope="" href="#concept-template_86a220a2-df7a-4973-be7b-fa58dba3dce7" target="" title="">Configure
                          response types</a> section.</li></ol></li></ul></p>
            </li></ol>
        </div>
            </td></tr>
            <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
              <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Create</span> to create a response.</p>
            </td></tr>
          </tbody></table>
        </div><div><article id="concept-template_86a220a2-df7a-4973-be7b-fa58dba3dce7" class="topic concept "><h6>
            <strong class="ph b">Configure response types</strong>
          </h6><div id="" class="body conbody">
            <p class="p">In Response Designer, you can configure channel-specific responses for the intents. For more
      information on how to create a response, see the  <a data-scope="" href="#task-template_336f85da-d3db-4427-b942-d5821752e630" target="" title="">Create a response</a>
      section.</p>
            <p class="p"> Refer to the following section for details:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#text-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure text response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#carousel-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure carousel response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#quick-reply-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure quick reply response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#image-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure image response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#video-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure video response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#audio-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure audio response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#file-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure file response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#reply-button-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure reply button response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#list-messages-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure list messages response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#numbered-list-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure numbered list response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#list-picker-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure list picker response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#time-picker-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure time picker response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#media-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure media response</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#rich-link-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure rich link response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#form-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure form response type</a></p>
        </li><li class="li">
          <p class="p"> <a data-scope="" href="#custom-events-response-type-configuration" target="" title="">Configure custom events response types</a></p>
        </li></ul></p>
          </div><div><article id="text-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure text response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure text messages as responses for all channels. To add a text response type for the chosen channel (default or custom), follow these steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">For the chosen channel, select <span class="ph uicontrol">Text</span> response type.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the text message in the <strong class="ph b">Variant</strong> textbox.</p>
        <div class="itemgroup info">You can customize agent responses using variables received from the channel or
          collected from customers during the conversation. You can also enter <code class="ph codeph">${</code>
          to choose the required variable in the text area.</div>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">To add multiple variants, click <strong class="ph b">Add Variant</strong> and enter the text message. </p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="carousel-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure carousel response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure carousel responses for Web (default) and Messenger channels. Each
        carousel response can contain an image, a description, and up to three buttons.Follow these
        steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">For the chosen channel, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Carousel</span> in the right pane. The
          rich carousel card appears.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Configure</span> to view or edit the image URL. By default, the
          system displays the image URL.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the <span class="ph uicontrol">Title</span> and <span class="ph uicontrol">Description
            (optional)</span> for the card. </p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">To send a configured payload to the AI agent and invoke the corresponding response for
          the intent, click <strong class="ph b">+ Add quick reply</strong>. </p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose the <strong class="ph b">Text</strong> button type and enter the text and payload/identifier. Click
                <strong class="ph b">Done</strong>.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">For URL redirection, choose the <strong class="ph b">URL</strong> button type (applicable only for Web
              channel), enter the text and URL, and click <strong class="ph b">Done</strong>.</p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Renew Now</span> to change the text and URL
              redirection.</div>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response. </p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="quick-reply-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure quick reply response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure quick reply responses for Web (default), SMS, Messenger, Apple Messages
        for Business, and RCS channels. Follow these steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">For the chosen channel, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Quick Reply</span> on the right
          pane.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the quick reply message for the intent.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">To send a configured payload to the AI agent, click <strong class="ph b">+ Add quick reply</strong>. Choose
          the <strong class="ph b">Text</strong> button type and enter the text and payload/identifier. Click <strong class="ph b">Done</strong>
          to add a text quick reply. </p>
        <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
            <p class="p">For URL redirection, choose the <strong class="ph b">URL</strong> button type (only applicable for Web
              chat), enter the text and URL, and click <strong class="ph b">Done</strong>.</p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
        <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
            <p class="p">A partial match happens when there's uncertainty about incoming user queries. AI
              agent responds with intents that are close to the user query as options. Partial match
              responses are displayed for the Web.</p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="image-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure image response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure image responses for Web (default), Messenger, and WhatsApp channels.
        Follow these steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">For the chosen channel, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Image</span> on the right pane. The image
          card appears with the default configurations.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Update the image URL.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> Choose the image type (jpeg or png).</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response. </p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="video-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure video response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure video responses for Web (default), Messenger, and WhatsApp channels.
        Follow these steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">For the chosen channel, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Video</span> on the right pane. The video
          card appears with the default configuration.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Update the video URL.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose the required video type (mp4).</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="audio-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure audio response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure audio responses for Web (default) and WhatsApp. Follow these steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">For the chosen channel, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Audio</span> in the right pane. The audio
          card appears with the default configuration.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Update the audio URL.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose the audio type (mp3 or aac).</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="file-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure file response type</strong>
  </h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id=""><p class="p">You can configure the file as a response for Web (default) and WhatsApp channels. Follow these
        steps:</p></section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">For the chosen channel, click <span class="ph uicontrol">File</span> on the right pane. The File
          card appears.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the file URL.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose the file type. Supported file types are .html, .pdf, plaintext, .jpeg, .png,
          .mp4, .mp3, and .aac.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="reply-button-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure reply button response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure reply button responses for the WhatsApp channel. Follow these steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Reply Button</span> in the right pane.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Configure the header details (Optional). </p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose the type of header—Text (can be 20 characters long), Video, Image,
              Document.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the value depending on the header type selected.</p>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the body text. This field can contain up to 1024 characters.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> Enter the footer text (optional). This field can contain up to 60 characters.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">To add a new reply button, click <strong class="ph b">Add button</strong>, enter the text and payload, and
          click <strong class="ph b">Done</strong></p>
        <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
            <p class="p">You can configure up to three reply buttons (with a 20-character limit).</p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response. </p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="list-messages-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure list messages response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure the list messages as responses for the WhatsApp channel. Follow these
        steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">List Messages</span> in the right pane.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to the <strong class="ph b">Configuration</strong> tab and configure the following settings: </p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">(Optional) Configure the header details (can be 20 characters long).</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the body text (can be 1024 characters long).</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">(Optional) Enter the footer text (can be 60 characters long).</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the List title.</p>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to the <strong class="ph b">List Sections</strong> tab and configure the following settings: </p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">(Optional) Enter the section name (can be 24 characters long).</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the row title (can be 24 characters long).</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the row ID, which is a unique identifier for each row that will help you
              identify the users’ choice.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the row description (can be 20 characters long).</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">To add a new section, click <strong class="ph b">Add section</strong>.</p>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="numbered-list-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure numbered list response type </strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure the numbered list as a response for the WhatsApp channel. Follow these
      steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Numbered List</span> in the right pane.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Edit the default text provided.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">+Add list item</strong>.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Under the <strong class="ph b">Text</strong> button type, configure the following: </p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the text and payload/identifier to send the payload to the AI agent when the
              user clicks the button.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Done</strong>.</p>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response. </p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="list-picker-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure list picker response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure list picker responses for the Apple Business Messages channel. Follow these
        steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">List Picker</span> in the right pane.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to the <strong class="ph b">Configuration</strong> tab and configure the following settings:</p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the list picker title.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">(Optional) Enter the preview image URL and choose the image style (Icon, Small,
              Large).</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the description for the list picker.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the title and description for the reply message based on the selected list
              picker option.</p>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to the <strong class="ph b">List sections</strong> tab and configure the following settings: </p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the title for items in the list.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the title for items in the list.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">In the <strong class="ph b">List Item</strong> field, configure the following settings:</p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ol class="">
                <li class="li">
                  <p class="p">Enter the image URL for the list item.</p>
                </li>
                <li class="li">
                  <p class="p">Enter a title.</p>
                </li>
                <li class="li">
                  <p class="p">Enter the identifier for an item. When a user selects an item, the identifier
                    is sent to the AI agent, which displays the next steps.</p>
                </li>
                <li class="li">
                  <p class="p">Enter the description for the list item.</p>
                </li>
                <li class="li">
                  <p class="p">To add another item, click the <strong class="ph b">+</strong> icon.</p>
                </li>
                <li class="li">
                  <p class="p">To delete an item, click the <strong class="ph b">Delete</strong> icon.</p>
                </li>
              </ol>
            </div>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">To add a new list section, click <strong class="ph b">Add List section</strong>. </p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="time-picker-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure time picker response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure time picker responses for the Apple Business Messages channel. Follow
        these steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Timer Picker</span> in the right pane.</p>
        <div class="itemgroup info">
          <p class="p">Navigate to the <strong class="ph b">Configuration</strong> tab and configure the following:</p>
        </div>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter a title for the time picker.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">(Optional) Enter the preview image URL and choose the image style (Icon, Small,
              Large).</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the description.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the title and description for the reply message based on the selected time
              picker option.</p>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to the <strong class="ph b">Event details</strong> tab and configure: </p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the event title.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the timezone for the event.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Configure slots:</p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ol class="">
                <li class="li">
                  <p class="p">Enter the date and time for slot1.</p>
                </li>
                <li class="li">Enter the duration for slot1.</li>
                <li class="li">Enter the identifier for the slot. When a user selects a slot, the identifier is
                  sent to the AI agent, which displays the next step.</li>
                <li class="li">To add a new slot, click <strong class="ph b">Add slot</strong>.</li>
              </ol>
            </div>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response. </p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="media-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure media response</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure media responses for the Apple Business Messages channel. Follow these
        steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Media</span> in the right pane.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the text.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose the media type and enter the URL.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> To add more attachments, click <strong class="ph b">Add attachments</strong>.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="rich-link-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure rich link response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure rich link responses for the Apple Business Messages channel. Follow these
        steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Rich Link</strong> in the right pane.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the image URL and choose the image type (jpeg or png). </p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> Enter the website URL for redirection.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> Enter the URL title for the video or image.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id=""> Enter the video URL supporting MIME protocol and choose the type (video/mp4).</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response. </p>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="form-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure form response type</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure form responses for the Apple Business Messages channel. Follow these
        steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Form</span> in the right pane.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the form in JSON format. Each JSON contains information about the pages that go
          as a part of the form with customizations. The pages can be of different types:</p>
        <div class="itemgroup info">
          <ul class="ul">
            <li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <strong class="ph b">Splash</strong>: An introduction page with a title, description, action button, and
                image.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <strong class="ph b">Select</strong>: A page for either a single "True/False" selection or multiple
                selections, supporting image assets.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <strong class="ph b">Picker</strong>: A page for a single selection from multiple options.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <strong class="ph b">Date Picker</strong>: Provides Apple's standard Date Picker with customizable date
                format and limits.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="li">
              <p class="p">
                <strong class="ph b">Input</strong>: A page featuring various input fields to collect information.</p>
            </li>
          </ul>
          <p class="p">The structured content metadata allows the user to specify the form's pages and visual
            layout. This template comprises two sections:</p>
          <ul class="ul">
            <li class="li">
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">BusinessFormEvent</strong>: Configures page identifiers, summary, pages, and
                images.</p>
            </li>
            <li class="li">
              <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">BusinessChatMessage</strong>: Configures received and reply message information.</p>
            </li>
          </ul>
          <p class="p">Click <strong class="ph b">Download sample JSON</strong> to download the sample JSON file and understand the
            form structure.</p>
          <p class="p">Refer to  <a data-scope="external" href="https://register.apple.com/resources/messages/msp-rest-api/type-interactive#form-message" target="_blank" title="">Apple's official documentation </a>for more
            information.</p>
        </div>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="custom-events-response-type-configuration" class="topic task "><h6><strong class="ph b">Configure custom events response types</strong></h6><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">You can configure custom events as responses for the voice channel. Follow these steps:</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Custom Events </strong>in the right pane. </p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the incoming event name that the AI agent receives.</p>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">In the <strong class="ph b">Voice settings</strong>, configure the following settings to be added to each
          agent response:</p>
        <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id=""><strong class="ph b">Timeout (s)</strong>: Specify the duration, in seconds, that the agent waits for a
              user response. If there's no response, you can set it to either prompt the user again
              or end the conversation. The default timeout is 5 seconds.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id=""><strong class="ph b">Timeout response</strong>: Specify the response message to be sent to the user if a
              timeout occurs.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id=""><strong class="ph b">Allow barge-in</strong>: Check this option to let the user interrupt the agent's
              response with new input. If unchecked, the user must wait until the agent has finished
              its response before responding.</p>
          </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
            <p class="ph cmd" id=""><strong class="ph b">DTMF input</strong>: Check this option to let users enter specific details through
              their keypad. This is helpful for gathering information expressed as long numbers.
              Enabling DTMF input allows you to configure the following settings:</p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
              <ul class="ul">
                <li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Input mode</strong>: Choose the required input mode to let the user respond with
                  DTMF only or using both – DTMF and voice.</li>
                <li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Timeout between digits (s):</strong> Set the maximum idle time allowed between
                  entering each digit. If the user exceeds this time, the digits entered so far are
                  sent to the flow as their input.</li>
                <li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Termination character</strong>: Specify the termination character, like # or *, to
                  mark the end of user input. When the user presses this key, the preceding keypad
                  input is sent to the flow as user input.</li>
                <li class="li">
                  <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Max length</strong>: Specify the maximum length of characters allowed for user
                    input.</p>
                </li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </li></ol>
      </td></tr>
      <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
        <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <strong class="ph b">Create</strong> to create the response.</p>
        <div class="itemgroup info">For configuring custom events for scripted AI agent, see the  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/article/n5uo60x" target="_blank" title="">Configure
            custom events</a> article.</div>
      </td></tr>
    </tbody></table></div></article></div></article></div></article></div></article></div><div><article id="task-template_d3113eca-9043-44af-a1ba-493fc6f90af8" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h4>Configure agent handover</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="context_ckk_t2s_zcc" /><div class="section prereq p" id="prereq_bkk_t2s_zcc"><div class="tasklabel"><p font-weight="bold" class="sectiontitle tasklabel cB_Bold">Before you begin</p></div>
      <p class="p">Create the scripted AI agent.</p>
    </div><table class="stepTable" id="steps_dkk_t2s_zcc" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Dashboard</span>, click the scripted AI agent that you've
          created. </p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to <span class="menucascade"><span class="ph uicontrol">Configuration</span> &gt; <span class="ph uicontrol"> Handover</span></span> and toggle on or off the required settings:</p>
            <ol type="a" class="ol substeps"><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                  <span class="ph uicontrol">Handover on partial match</span>—A number of consecutive partial
              matches in a session can initiate a handover. This number is configurable.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                  <span class="ph uicontrol">Handover on fallback</span>—A number of consecutive fallback
              messages in a session can initiate an agent handover. This number is configurable in
              the provided text box.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                  <span class="ph uicontrol">Handover after repeated agent responses</span>—Consecutive repeated
              messages in a session can initiate agent handover. The number of repetitions needed
              for this trigger is configurable.</p>
              </li><li class="li substep substepexpand">
                <p class="ph cmd" id="">
                  <span class="ph uicontrol">Handover when slot filling retry limit reached</span>—When the
              retry attempts for the slot filling is reached to the maximum limit, it initiates an
              agent handover. </p>
              </li></ol>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Save changes</span>.</p>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table><section class="section postreq" id="postreq_vzn_jjg_1dc"><div class="tasklabel"><p font-weight="bold" class="sectiontitle tasklabel cB_Bold">What to do next</p></div>Navigate to the  <a data-scope="local" href="#concept-template_7950670d-af45-4860-90b9-db9ea8dccef3" target="" title="">preview your Scripted AI Agent</a>. </section></div></article></div><div><article id="task-template_f628b019-be9c-483e-92ea-b870a6b51a50" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h4>Configure language and voice</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="context_fjd_zjm_g2c">
      <p class="p">You can configure multiple languages and language-specific voices for the scripted AI agent
        to handle customer interactions. </p>
    </section><div class="section prereq p" id="prereq_tvg_3hc_1dc"><div class="tasklabel"><p font-weight="bold" class="sectiontitle tasklabel cB_Bold">Before you begin</p></div>
      <p class="p">Create the Scripted AI Agent.</p>
    </div><table class="stepTable" id="steps_fyp_g31_xcc" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the AI agent configuration page, navigate to the <span class="menucascade"><span class="ph uicontrol">Configuration</span> &gt; <span class="ph uicontrol">Language</span></span> tab.</p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22"             <p class="p">The default language and voice are set to English. For other supported languages and
              voices, see the  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/pdef2d/Supported-languages-for-Scripted-AI-Agents" target="_blank" title="">Supported languages and voices</a> article.</p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">To add more languages to the AI agent, click <span class="ph uicontrol">+Add
          language</span>.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose the desired language and locale from the drop-down list and click
            <span class="ph uicontrol">Add</span>. </p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Add languages</span>. The newly added language appears in the
            <span class="ph uicontrol">Language </span> tab with the <span class="ph uicontrol">Enabled</span> toggle set
          to 'on' by default.</p>

            <p class="p">Adding more than one language enables the <span class="ph uicontrol">Polymatch</span>

        </div>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Choose the appropriate voice from the <span class="ph uicontrol">Voice Name</span> drop-down list.
          The available voices automatically appear based on the chosen language.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">To set the desired language and voice as defaults for the AI agent, click
            <span class="ph uicontrol">Set as default</span> under <span class="ph uicontrol">Controls</span> column. </p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22"             <p class="p">You can’t remove the default language and voice, but you can change them as needed.
              Changing the default language might impact responses, intents, curation, testing, and
              preview experiences.</p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="concept-template_882552ff-3375-4221-93fe-e9bbd916bc02" class="topic concept "><h4>Configure fulfillment</h4><div id="" class="body conbody">
        <p class="p">You can configure the fulfillment for the scripted AI agents to interact with external
      systems and retrieve, update, or store data through APIs. For more information, see the  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/article/mzpuseb" target="_blank" title="">Configure
        fulfillment for scripted AI agents</a> article.</p>
      </div></article></div></article></div>
  <div><article id="concept-template_7950670d-af45-4860-90b9-db9ea8dccef3" class="topic concept "><h3>Preview your scripted AI agent</h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p">
        Webex AI Agent Studio allows you to preview your AI agents during and after development. This feature lets
            you test how your AI agent works and check if it provides the expected responses to
            different input queries. You can preview your scripted AI agent in the following
            ways:</p>
      <p class="p">You can open the preview from: <ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">AI agent dashboard</strong>—When you hover over an AI agent card, the
                        <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> option appears for that AI agent. Click it to
                    open the preview.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">AI agent header</strong>—Click the AI agent card to open the agent. The
                        <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> option is always visible in the header
                    section.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Minimized widget</strong>—After you launch the preview and minimize it, a chat
                    head widget appears at the bottom right of the page. You can use this widget to
                    easily reopen the preview mode.</li></ul>
        </p>
      <section id="section_u3r_33x_wcc" class="section">
            <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Platform preview widget</h4>
            <p class="p">The preview widget appears at the bottom right of the screen. You can enter
                utterances (or a sequence of utterances) to see how the AI agent responds, helping
                you confirm it works as expected. The AI agent preview supports multiple languages
                and can automatically detect the language of your input. You can also manually
                select the language in the preview by clicking the language selector and choosing
                from the available options.</p>
            <p class="p">You can maximize the preview widget for a better view. You can also provide consumer
                information and start multiple rooms to thoroughly test the AI agent.</p>
        </section>
    </div><div><article id="task-template_1bacff9f-0e09-41f5-8b78-3b87bdd7e170" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h4>Preview chat conversation</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      
      <p class="p">The chat preview feature lets you interact with the AI agent as an end user and observe how
        it responds to different queries through text.</p>
      <p class="p">If AI transparency is enabled, preview includes the disclosure experience so you can verify
        the first AI-generated reply before you publish the agent.</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the AI agent configuration page, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> in the header. The AI agent
          preview widget appears.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Start a Chat</span>. If AI transparency is enabled, the preview
          prepends the transparency note to the first AI-generated response in the session.</p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
            <p class="p">
              <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                  <p class="p">By default, you can preview chat conversations in the English language
                    (en-US).</p>
                </li><li class="li">
                  <p class="p">(Available in Beta) You can preview chat conversations in the other languages
                    you've configured. To configure more languages, refer to the  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ncs9r37/Webex-AI-Agent-Studio-Administration-guide#task-template_f628b019-be9c-483e-92ea-b870a6b51a50" target="_blank" title="">Configure Language and Voice</a>
                    section.</p>
                </li></ul>
            </p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Type your query in the text box and press <span class="ph uicontrol">Enter</span>.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">You can then see and assess the response from AI agent.</p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">To start a new chat conversation or session, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> in
          the header. Restart the session to verify the transparency note again. </div>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="task-template_0d438e02-c62e-44c2-a8cb-a10f584092e1" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h4>Preview voice conversation</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="context_j13_cvq_dgc">
      
      <p class="p">The voice preview feature lets you interact with the AI agent as an end user and observe
        how it responds to different queries through voice.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span><ul class="ul"><li class="li"><p class="p">You need browser permissions to preview voice conversations. When prompted by your
                browser, make sure to click 'Allow' to enable the required access. We recommend
                using the following browsers:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">Safari on macOS</li><li class="li">Chrome on Windows</li></ul></p></li><li class="li">Use a headset for the best experience. When a caller interrupts the AI agent (via
              barge-in), the AI agent detects the speech, stops the prompt that it is playing, and
              processes the caller's input accordingly—this works optimally only when you are using
              a headset.</li><li class="li">When not using a headset, avoid setting the volume to 100%. </li></ul></div></div></div></div></p>
      <p class="p">If AI transparency is enabled, preview includes the disclosure before the AI interaction
        continues so you can verify the voice experience before you publish the agent.</p>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="steps_k13_cvq_dgc" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the AI agent configuration page, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Preview</span> in the header.
          The AI agent preview widget appears. </p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Voice your query. As you speak, you can see the live transcript of the
          conversation.</p>
            <div class="itemgroup info">
          <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22"
