            <p class="p">To mute your voice while interacting, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Mute</span>. </p>
          </div></div></div></div>
        </div>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">For your query, you can then hear and assess the response from the AI agent.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">To end the call, click <span class="ph uicontrol">End call</span>.</p>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table></div></article></div></article></div>
  <div><article id="task-template_839bb67a-b321-4045-a556-f8799d6a0ac9" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h3>Publish your scripted AI agent</h3><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="">
      <p class="p">
        <?oxy-placeholder content="Paragraph in Context (Untitled Context-Setting Paragraph)"?>
      </p>
      <p class="p"> After configuring and previewing your AI agent, you can publish the agent to make it
        live.</p>
    </section><div class="section prereq p" id=""><div class="tasklabel"><p font-weight="bold" class="sectiontitle tasklabel cB_Bold">Before you begin</p></div>
      <p class="p">Create the scripted AI agent.</p>
    </div><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">On the AI agent configuration page, click <strong class="ph b">Publish</strong>.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Enter the version name and click <strong class="ph b">Publish</strong>.</p>
          <div class="itemgroup info">
          <p class="p">You can view the version details on the <strong class="ph b">History</strong> page. For more information, see
            the History section. </p>
        </div>
        </td></tr>
      </tbody></table></div></article></div>
  <div><article id="concept-template_a91f6514-6e3a-4084-a36b-f583530f30c3" class="topic concept "><h3>Common management sections for Scripted AI Agent</h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p">The following sections appear on the left panel of the AI Agent configuration page:</p>
    </div><div><article id="concept-template_a2c9cfa0-3c80-42fb-8dca-ae3a25dd78c9" class="topic concept "><h4>Test scripted agent</h4><div id="" class="body conbody">
        <p class="p">As AI agents evolve and become more complex, changes to their logic or Natural Language Understanding (NLU) can sometimes have unintended consequences. To ensure optimal performance and identify potential issues, the AI agent platform offers a convenient one-click AI agent testing framework. You can:</p>
        <ul class="ul">
          <li class="li">Easily create and run a comprehensive set of test cases. </li>
          <li class="li">Define test messages and expected responses for various scenarios.</li>
          <li class="li">Simulate complex interactions by creating test cases with multiple messages.</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="p">
      <?oxy-placeholder content="Paragraph"?>
    </p>
        <section id="section_nyz_m5w_1dc" class="section">
      <h5 class="title sectiontitle">Define tests</h5>
      <p class="p">You can define tests using the following steps:</p>
      <ol class=""><li class="li">Log in to the Webex AI Agent Studio platform.</li><li class="li">On the <strong class="ph b">Dashboard</strong>, click the scripted AI agent that you've created. </li><li class="li">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Testing</span> in the left pane. By default, the
            <span class="ph uicontrol">Testcases</span> tab appears.</li><li class="li">Select a test case and click <span class="ph uicontrol">Execute selected tests</span>.</li></ol>
      <p class="p">Each row in the table represents a test case having the following parameters:</p>
      <table width="100%" border="1"><caption><span class="table--title-label table title">Table 3. </span><span class="tabletitle">Test cases</span></caption><thead><tr><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">Parameter</th><th id="" font-weight="bold" align="">Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td headers="" align="">Message</td><td headers="" align="">A sample message that represents the types of queries and statements you can
                expect users to send to your AI agent. </td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Expected language</td><td headers="" align="">The language in which the you interact with the AI agent.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Expected intent</td><td headers="" align="">Specify the intent to be displayed in response to a particular user message. To assist you in finding the most relevant intent, this column features a <span class="ph uicontrol">Smart auto-complete function</span>. As you enter, the system suggests matching intents based on the text entered so far.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Reset previous context</td><td headers="" align="">Click the check box to isolate test cases and run them independently of any existing AI agent context. When enabled, each test case is simulated in a new session, preventing interference from previous interactions, or stored data.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Include partial matches</td><td headers="" align="">Enable this toggle to consider test cases successful even if the expected intents only partially match the actual response.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Import from CSV</td><td headers="" align="">Import test cases from a comma-separated file (CSV) file. In this case, all
                existing test cases are overwritten. </td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Export to CSV</td><td headers="" align="">Export test cases to a comma-separated file (CSV) file.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Test callbacks</td><td headers="" align="">Enable this toggle to simulate incoming callbacks and test the flow behavior without requiring actual incoming calls.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Callback in flow</td><td headers="" align="">Click the check box in this column to indicate that an intent must trigger a callback.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Expected callback template</td><td headers="" align="">Specify the template key to activate when the callback occurs.</td></tr><tr><td headers="" align="">Callback timeout (s)</td><td headers="" align="">The maximum amount of time (in seconds) the AI agent waits for a callback response before considering the callback as timed out. The system allows a maximum of 20-second timeout.</td></tr></tbody></table>
    </section>
        <section id="section_jnr_q5w_1dc" class="section">
      <h5 class="title sectiontitle">Execute tests</h5>
      <p class="p">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">Execution</span> tab, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Execute selected
          tests</span> to initiate a sequential execution of all selected test cases. <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 6.1875V15.8125C2.75107 16.7239 3.11358 17.5976 3.75801 18.242C4.40243 18.8864 5.27615 19.2489 6.1875 6.38886C15.4822 6.25993 15.3073 6.1875 15.125 6.1875Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path d="M15.125 9.625H6.875C6.69266 9.625 6.5178 9.69743 6.38886 9.82636C6.25993 9.9553 6.1875 10.1302 6.1875 10.3125C6.1875 10.4948 6.25993 10.6697 6.38886 10.7986C6.5178 10.9276 6.69266 11 6.875 11H15.125C15.3073 11 15.4822 10.9276 15.6111 10.7986C15.7401 10.6697 15.8125 10.4948 15.8125 10.3125C15.8125 10.1302 15.7401 9.9553 15.6111 9.82636C15.4822 9.69743 15.3073 9.625 15.125 9.625Z" fill="#1170CF" /><path d="M10.3125 13.0625H6.875C6.69266 13.0625 6.5178 13.1349 6.38886 13.2639C6.25993 13.3928 6.1875 13.5677 6.1875 13.75C6.1875 13.9323 6.25993 14.1072 6.38886 14.2361C6.5178 14.3651 6.69266 14.4375 6.875 14.4375H10.3125C10.4948 14.4375 10.6697 14.3651 10.7986 14.2361C10.9276 14.1072 11 13.9323 11 13.75C11 13.5677 10.9276 13.3928 10.7986 13.2639C10.6697 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span><p class="p">You can also execute test cases from the <strong class="ph b">Test cases</strong>
            tab.</p>.</div></div></div></div>As each test case completes, the system displays its result next to the
        corresponding entry. To terminate a running test case, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Abort
          Run</span> at the top-right corner of the screen.</p>
      <p class="p">To view test cases with specific outcomes, click the desired result (for example,
          <code class="ph codeph">Passed</code>, <code class="ph codeph">Passed with partial match</code>,
          <code class="ph codeph">Failed</code>, <code class="ph codeph">Pending</code>) in the summary ribbon. This filters the
        test case list to display only those matching the selected result.</p>
      <p class="p">The <code class="ph codeph">session ID</code> associated with each test case is displayed in the results. This allows you to quickly cross-reference test cases and view transaction details. To perform this, choose the <code class="ph codeph">Transaction Details</code> option in the <span class="ph uicontrol">Actions</span> column.</p>
    </section>
        <section id="section_c43_s5w_1dc" class="section">
      <h5 class="title sectiontitle">Execution history</h5>
      <p class="p">On the <span class="ph uicontrol">History</span> tab, access all executed test cases. <ul class="ul"><li class="li">Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Download</span> icon from the <span class="ph uicontrol">Actions</span> column to export the executed test data as a CSV file for offline analysis or reporting. </li><li class="li">Review the specific engine and algorithm settings used for each test case execution.
            This information helps developers optimize the AI agent's performance. </li><li class="li">To view the advanced algorithm configuration settings used for a particular training
            engine, click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Info</span> icon next to the training engine name.
            This provides insights into the parameters and settings that influenced the AI agent's
            behavior during testing.</li></ul></p>
    </section>
      </div></article></div><div><article id="concept-template_edb280bf-311f-4a59-981b-27e4d0190228" class="topic concept "><h4>View agent sessions</h4><div id="" class="body conbody">
        <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Sessions</span> section provides a comprehensive record of all interactions between AI agents and customers. Each session includes a detailed history of messages exchanged. You can export session data as a CSV file for offline analysis and auditing. Use this data to analyze user interactions, identify areas for improvement, and refine AI agent responses.</p>
        <p class="p">It can handle large data sets by displaying results on pages. You can use the
        <span class="ph uicontrol">Refine Results</span> section to filter and sort sessions based on various
      criteria. Each row in the table displays essential session details, including:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Channels</strong>—The channel where the interaction occurred (for example, chat,
          voice).</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Session ID</strong>—A unique identifier for the session.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Consumer ID</strong>—The unique identifier of the user.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Messages</strong>—The number of messages exchanged during the session.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Updated at</strong>—The last updated system time.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Metadata</strong>—Additional information about the session.<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Hide test sessions</strong>—Check this check box to hide the test sessions and display
              only the list of live sessions.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Agent handover happened</strong>—Check this check box to filter sessions that we hand
              over to an agent. If agent handover happens, it displays the headphone icon indicating
              the handover of the chat to a human agent. </li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Error occurred</strong>—Check this check box to filter the sessions in which an error
              occurred.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Downvoted</strong>—Check this check box to filter the downvoted sessions.</li></ul></li></ul></p>
        <p class="p">Click on a row to access the detailed view of a specific session. Use check boxes to filter sessions based on agent handover, errors, and downvotes. Decrypting sessions requires user-level permission and advanced data protection settings. Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Decrypt content</span> to view the session details.</p>
        <section id="section_w2r_bvw_1dc" class="section">
      <h5 class="title sectiontitle">View session details in the scripted AI agent</h5>
      <p class="p">Click the session in each row to view the individual session details. </p>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Transaction Info</span> tab provides a detailed breakdown of a specific
        interaction, categorizing information into four sections:</p>
      <p class="p">The <strong class="ph b">Messages</strong> section:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">Shows a transcript of all session interactions in chronological order, providing
            context for the conversation.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358               <p class="p">AI Agent transcripts are stored for 90 days before being automatically purged.</p>
            </div></div></div></div></li><li class="li">Shows the corresponding responses generated by the AI Agent.</li><li class="li">Shows the recording playback modal (along with the session transcript) for
            conversations between the AI agent and the customer. Recordings are available only for
            voice sessions, not chat sessions. You can play the recording from the beginning or jump
            to a specific point. <p class="p">The recording playback modal provides a suite of audio
                controls:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Play/Pause</strong>: Click <image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477194.png" alt="Play icon" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477194.png" width="" height="" /> to start listening to the interaction session and click <image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477195.png" alt="Pause icon" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477195.png" width="" height="" /> to pause the recording playback. </li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Playback speed</strong>: Click 1X to adjust the audio playback speed, ranging from
                  0.5X to 2X.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Sound control</strong>: Click <image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477197.png" alt="Sound icon" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/470001-480000/477001-478000/477197.png" width="" height="" /> to mute or unmute the sound of the audio during playback. You can also use the
                  volume slider to adjust the playback volume.</li></ul><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 13.1349 10.4948 13.0625 10.3125 13.0625Z" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
                <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
                    <p class="p">When conversations contain PCI data, the system enforces enhanced security
                      measures. Depending on the scenario:</p>
                    <p class="p">
                      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">If PCI data is detected, the playback modal for the recording is
                          disabled in the session view, preventing access to the audio.</li><li class="li">When using secure entities, recording is automatically muted during the
                          portions where PCI data is present, ensuring sensitive information is not
                          audible.</li></ul>
                    </p>
                  </li><li class="li">When a call is escalated from an AI agent to a human agent, and the human
                    agent then consults back to the same or another AI agent, the recording of the
                    consulted leg is currently not supported. </li></ul>
              </div></div></div></div></p></li></ul></p>
      
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Intents Identified</span> section:</p>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">Displays the intents identified for the customer's query.</li><li class="li">Indicates the confidence level associated with each identified intent.</li><li class="li">Lists the slots that are associated with the identified intent. Click the slot to view
          additional information about its value and how the system extracts it from the user's
          query.</li></ul>
      <p class="p"><span class="ph uicontrol">Entities Identified</span> section lists the entities that the system
        extracts from the customer's message and associates it with the active consumer intent.
        These entities represent the key pieces of information that the AI Agent identified within
        the user's query.</p>
      <p class="p">The <strong class="ph b">Algorithm Results</strong> section provides insights into the underlying processes that
        led to the AI Agent's response. Here's a breakdown of the information displayed:</p>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">List of Intents</strong>—Shows the identified intents and their corresponding similarity
          scores.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Entity List</strong>—Displays the entities that were extracted from the user's
          message.</li></ul>
      <p class="p">The <strong class="ph b">Other Info</strong> displays:</p>
      <ol class=""><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Processed Query</strong>—Indicates the preprocessed version of the customer's input after
          the AI Agent's natural language understanding (NLU) pipeline processes it.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Language detection provider</strong>—The provider who offers technology that can
          automatically identify the language of a given text.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Language detected</strong>—The language detected by technology.  </li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Agent Handover</strong>—Indicates whether an agent handover occurred during the session.
          Check the <span class="ph uicontrol">Agent Handover by Rules</span> check box if an agent handover
          was triggered by specific rules.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Template Key</strong>—Indicates the template key associated with the intent that triggered
          the AI agent's response. </li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Response Type</strong>—Indicates the type of response generated by the AI agent.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Response Condition</strong>—Indicates the specific condition or rule that triggered the AI
          agent's response.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">NLU AI Engine</strong>—Identifies the NLU AI engine used to process the customer's
          query.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Vector model</strong>—A way of representing text as numerical vectors.  </li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Min threshold Scores</strong>—Displays the minimum threshold score.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Partial match score difference</strong>—The partial match score difference configured in
          the <strong class="ph b">Handover and Inference</strong> settings. The system determines whether a query is out
          of scope or requires agent intervention based on these values.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Debug Logs</strong>—Provides a list of debug logs associated with the specific transaction
          ID. Advanced logs are typically retained for 180 days.</li></ol>
      <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
        <p class="p">You can also download and view the transaction info in the JSON format using the download
          option.</p>
      </div></div></div></div>
      
      
    </section>
      </div></article></div><div><article id="concept-template_6f7b8836-c807-4c55-9c37-2f2a67cf429e" class="topic concept "><h4>View version history and change logs</h4><div id="" class="body conbody">
        <p class="p">Whenever you add or update intents or entities, the system retrains your scripted AI agent to
      keep it up to date. After each training session, test your AI agent thoroughly to ensure
      accuracy and effectiveness. Each time you publish a scripted AI agent, a version is saved and
      accessible in the <strong class="ph b">Version History</strong> tab, where you can view all versions of the scripted
      AI agent.</p>
        <p class="p">The <strong class="ph b">History</strong> page allows you to access the following updates made to your agents:</p>
        <ul class="ul">
          <li class="li">Track when you published the version history and the changes made in the form of a note left by developers when publishing.  </li>
          <li class="li">View the AI engine used for each published version, along with its settings. You can also
        see the time elapsed to get each version ready to publish.  </li>
          <li class="li">Monitor changes to settings, intents, entities, responses, and curation in the <strong class="ph b">Change logs</strong> tab.</li>
          <li class="li">Publish, Preview, or Load an older version as draft if needed.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">View Training History</strong>—Track when you trained a corpus and the changes made.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">Compare Training Engines</strong>—Review the training engines used for different iterations
        and their corresponding training durations.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">Track changes</strong>—Monitor changes to settings, intents, responses, and curation.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">Revert to previous versions</strong>—Easily revert to an older training set if needed.</li>
        </ul>
        <section id="section_ik3_fvw_1dc" class="section">
      <h5 class="title sectiontitle">Change Logs</h5>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Change Logs</span> section provides a detailed record of modifications
        made to your scripted AI agent. To access change logs:</p>
      <ol class=""><li class="li">Navigate to the <strong class="ph b">Dashboard</strong> and click the AI agent that you've created.</li><li class="li">Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Version History</span> tab to view the AI agent's
          history.</li><li class="li">Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Change Logs</span> tab to see a detailed log of changes:<ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Updated at</strong>—The date and time the system made the change.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Updated by</strong>—The user who made the change.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Change Location</strong>—The section of the AI agent where the modification occurred
              (for example, Corpus, Intent, and Response).</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Description</strong>—Additional details about the change.</li></ul></li></ol>
      <div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358 3.75801 3.75801C3.11358 4.40243 2.75107 5.27615 2.75 fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
        <ul class="ul"><li class="li">
            <p class="p">Use the <code class="ph codeph">Updated by</code> and <code class="ph codeph">Change Location</code> search
              options to find specific change log entries. </p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Version History</span> tab displays a maximum of 10 corpora for
              each AI agent.</p>
          </li></ul>
      </div></div></div></div>
    </section>
      </div></article></div><div><article id="concept-template_926ff668-f78c-491f-bda5-0268609bab8c" class="topic concept "><h4>Curate scripted AI agent</h4><div id="" class="body conbody">
        <p class="p">The system adds messages to the <span class="ph uicontrol">Curation</span> console based on the
      following criteria:</p>
        <ul class="ul">
          <li class="li">
            <span class="ph uicontrol">Fallback Messages</span>—When the AI agent fails to understand your
        message and triggers the fallback intent.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">Downvoted Messages</strong>—Messages that users have downvoted during AI agent
        previews.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">Agent Handover</strong>—Messages that result in a human agent handover due to configured
        rules.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">From Session</strong>—Messages flagged by users as not receiving the desired response from
        session or room data.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">Low Confidence</strong>—Messages with a confidence score falling within the specified
        low-confidence threshold.</li>
          <li class="li">
            <strong class="ph b">Partial Match</strong>—Messages where the AI agent couldn't figure out the right intent or
        response.</li>
        </ul>
        <section id="section_uzj_s5w_1dc" class="section">
      <h5 class="title sectiontitle">Resolve issues</h5>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Issues</span> tab allows you to review and address messages flagged for
        curation. You can do the following:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">Choose to resolve or ignore issues based on their severity and relevance. </li><li class="li">Examine the original user utterance, the AI Agent's response, and any attached
            media.</li></ul>You can view the full content of encrypted sessions by using the <span class="ph uicontrol">Decrypt
          Content</span> option, if you’ve decrypt access enabled.<div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span           <p class="p">If the <strong class="ph b">Advanced Data Protection</strong> is enabled in the backend, the system grants the
            decrypted access at the user level.</p>
        </div></div></div></div></p>
      <p class="p">To resolve an issue, you can:<ul class="ul"><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Link to an existing intent</strong>—To connect an issue to an existing intent, select
              the <span class="ph uicontrol">Link</span> option and search for the desired intent.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Add to a new intent</strong>—Use the <span class="ph uicontrol">Add to a New Intent</span> option
              to create a new intent directly from the Curation Console.</p>
          </li><li class="li">
            <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Ignore issues</strong>—Resolve or ignore issues to remove them from the Curation
              Console.</p>
          </li></ul><ol class=""><li class="li">You can't link to default intents (welcome message, fallback message, partial
            match).</li><li class="li">For a scripted AI agent, select the appropriate intent from the drop-down list and tag
            any relevant entities.</li><li class="li">After making changes, the system retrains your AI agent to ensure that it reflects the
            new knowledge in its responses.</li><li class="li">Resolve or ignore multiple issues simultaneously for efficient management.</li></ol></p>
      <p class="p">The <span class="ph uicontrol">Resolved</span> tab displays all issues addressed by the system. You can view a summary of each resolved issue, including whether we linked it to an existing intent, created a new intent, or ignored it. If you see responses that you don't like that the system didn't catch, you can manually add specific examples to the Curation Console.</p>
      <p class="p">To add issues from sessions:<ol class=""><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Identify the Utterance</strong>—Locate the utterance that triggered the incorrect
            response.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Check Curation Status</strong>—If the issue isn't already in the Curation Console, the
            system displays the <code class="ph codeph">Curation Status</code> toggle.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">Toggle the Flag</strong>—Enable the <code class="ph codeph">Curation Status</code> toggle to add the
            utterance to the Curation Console for review and resolution.</li></ol><div class="olh_note"><div class="note__content"><div class="olh_note" role="note"><div class="note-container"><span class="svg-container"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M15.8125 2.75H6.1875C5.27615 2.75107 4.40243 3.11358           <p class="p">If the issue is already in the Curation Console, the toggle's appearance changes to show its status.</p>
        </div></div></div></div></p>
    </section>
      </div></article></div></article></div>
  <div><article id="concept-template_cb93923b-e1b2-4803-a125-4b336d4580fd" class="topic concept "><h3>View your scripted AI agent performance using Analytics</h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p"> The <strong class="ph b">Analytics</strong> section provides a graphical representation of key metrics to evaluate
      the AI agent performance and effectiveness. The key metrics are divided into four sections
      represented as tabs, namely <span class="ph uicontrol">Overview</span>, <span class="ph uicontrol">Responses</span>,
        <span class="ph uicontrol">Training</span>, and <span class="ph uicontrol">Curation</span>.</p>
      <p class="p">On the Analytics page, you can select the AI agent you want to see the analytics for. You can
      customize the analytics view by choosing the channel, date range, and data granularity. By
      default, the system displays analytics data for the last month for all channels, with each day
      as a data point.</p>
      <section id="section_uvx_lzp_wcc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Overview</h4>
      <p class="p">The overview contains key metrics and graphs that provide a snapshot of overall AI agent
        usage and performance to the developers.</p>
      <ol class=""><li class="li">From the <strong class="ph b">Dashboard</strong>, choose the AI agent that you've created.</li><li class="li">On the left navigation pane, click <strong class="ph b">Analytics</strong>. An overview of the AI agent performance appears in both tabular format and graphical representation.</li></ol>
      <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Sessions and messages</strong></p>
      <p class="p">The first section in the overview displays the following statistics about sessions and
        messages for the AI agent:</p>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">The count of the total sessions and the sessions that the AI agent handles without human intervention.</li><li class="li">Total agent handovers, which is a count of the number of sessions handed over to human
          agents.</li><li class="li">Daily average sessions</li><li class="li">Total messages (human and AI agent messages) and how many of those messages came from
          users.</li><li class="li">Daily average messages</li></ul>
      <p class="p">The system follows this with a graphical representation of sessions (stacked column representing sessions handled by the AI agent and sessions handed over) and the total responses sent out by the AI agent.</p>
      <p class="p" />
      <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Users</strong></p>
      <p class="p">The second section in the overview contains stats about users for the AI agent. It provides
        a count of total users and information about average sessions per user and daily average
        users. This is followed by a graph displaying new and returning users for each unit
        depending on the selected granularity.</p>
      <p class="p"><strong class="ph b">Performance</strong></p>
      <p class="p">The third section provides statistics about the AI agent’s responses to users. Here one can see the total responses sent out by the AI agent and the split up between responses where the AI agent:</p>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">Identified the user’s intent.</li><li class="li">Responded with a fallback message.</li><li class="li">Responded with a partial match message.</li><li class="li">Informed the user of an agent handover.</li></ul>
      <p class="p">The same is aggregated in a pie chart and an area graph provides information based on selected granularity.</p>
    </section>
      <section id="section_csm_vw5_1dc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Training</h4>
      <p class="p">The training section represents of the ‘health’ of an AI agent corpus. It’s recommended
        that developers configure 20+ training utterances for each intent in their AI Agents. This
        section displays all intents as rectangles, with color and size indicating the amount of
        training data. The closer an intent is to white color, the more training data it needs for
        your AI Agent’s accuracy to improve.</p>
    </section>
      <section id="section_vch_vzp_wcc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Responses</h4>
      <p class="p">This section gives a detailed view of what the customers are asking about and how often
        they are asking it. It graphically shows the most popular intents for AI agents for
        answering questions and response templates for AI Agents for performing actions.</p>
      <p class="p">This section provides a detailed view of customer inquiries and their frequency. It
        visually displays the most popular intents and response types that AI agents use to solve
        customer queries.</p>
      <figure />
    </section>
      <section id="section_j5x_11q_wcc" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Curation</h4>
      <p class="p">This section visually summarizes the number of curation issues that arise each day and the number that AI agents resolve.</p>
    </section>
    </div></article></div>
</article>
  </main>
</div>

  <div><article id="concept-template_5c92bed9-7ad7-4117-a0ef-06ac55bf181e" class="topic concept "><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p">This section outlines how to integrate AI agents with both voice and digital channels to
      manage customer conversations.</p>
    </div></article></div>
  <div><article id="generic-template_43f4e186-63f4-4ed0-b4cd-aa2b6aea7485" class="topic "><h3>Use AI agents for voice and digital interactions</h3><div id="" class="body taskbody">
      <p class="p">After you've created and configured your autonomous or scripted AI agents in the Webex AI Agent Studio platform, the next step is to integrate them with the voice and digital channels. This
      integration allows the AI agents to handle both voice-based and digital conversations with
      your customers, providing a seamless and interactive user experience.</p>
      <p class="p">For more information, see <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/article/s0qro1" target="_blank" title=""> Use AI agents for voice and digital interactions</a> article.</p>
    </div></article></div>
</article>
  </main>
</div>

  <div><article id="task-template_eef8283c-fed9-4307-b1f7-b6d3aabd7a50" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h3>Create a global variable</h3><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="" /><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Sign in to  <a data-scope="external" href="https://admin.webex.com/login" target="_blank" title="">Control Hub</a>.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">From the <span class="ph uicontrol">Contact Center</span> navigation pane, choose <span class="menucascade"><span class="ph uicontrol">Flows &gt; Global Variables</span></span>.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Create a new global variable</span> and provide the name and description for the variable. Create a variable with the name <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome</span>. Choose <span class="ph uicontrol">String</span> as the variable type.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Toggle <span class="ph uicontrol">Make Reportable</span> on to display the variable in Analyzer for reporting purposes.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Save</span>.</p>
        </td></tr>
      </tbody></table></div></article></div>

fill="#1170CF" /></svg></span>
        <p class="p">The following instructions are also available within the linked sample flow import.</p>
      </div></div></div></div>
    </section><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Sign in to your customer organization using  <a data-scope="external" href="https://admin.webex.com/login" target="_blank" title="">Control Hub</a>.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Navigate to <span class="menucascade"><span class="ph uicontrol">Contact Center &gt; Customer Experience &gt; Flows</span></span>. The Flows page appears.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Go to Flow Designer</span> icon beside the flow. The <span class="ph uicontrol">Flow Designer</span> window appears.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">In the <span class="ph uicontrol">Global Flow Properties</span> pane, scroll down to <span class="menucascade"><span class="ph uicontrol">Variable Definition &gt; Predefined Variables</span></span> section.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">In the <span class="ph uicontrol">Global Variables</span> section, click <span class="ph uicontrol">Add Global Variables</span>. Add the global variable <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome</span> to your flow.</p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Use the <span class="ph uicontrol">Set Variable </span> activity to assign the value <strong class="ph b">ABANDONED</strong> to the variable <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome</span>.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489218.png" alt="Cisco Webex Flow Designer with the Set Variable activity opened to assign the value ABANDONED to the variable CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome." data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489218.png" width="" height="" /></p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">7</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Configure your <span class="ph uicontrol">Virtual Agent V2</span> activity in the flow.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489219.png" alt="Cisco Webex Flow Designer with the Virtual Agent V2 activity in the flow." data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489219.png" width="" height="" /></p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">8</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Connect the Handled outcome of the <span class="ph uicontrol">Virtual Agent V2</span> Activity and use the <span class="ph uicontrol">Set Variable </span> activity to assign the value <strong class="ph b">HANDLED </strong>to the variable <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome</span>.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489220.png" alt="Cisco Webex Flow Designer with the Set Variable activity opened to assign the value HANDLED to the variable CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome." data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489220.png" width="" height="" /></p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">9</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Connect the Escalated outcome of the <span class="ph uicontrol">Virtual Agent V2 </span> activity and use the <span class="ph uicontrol">Set Variable </span> activity to assign the value <strong class="ph b">ESCALATED</strong> to the variable <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome</span>.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489221.png" alt="Cisco Webex Flow Designer with ESCALATED set to the variable CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome." data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489221.png" width="" height="" /></p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">10</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Connect the errored path of the <span class="ph uicontrol">Virtual Agent V2 </span> activity and use the <span class="ph uicontrol">Set Variable </span> activity to assign the value <strong class="ph b">ERRORED</strong> to the variable <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome</span>.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489222.png" alt="Cisco Webex Flow Designer with set variable selected" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489222.png" width="" height="" /></p>
        </td></tr>
        <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">11</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
          <p class="ph cmd" id="">Complete the rest of the flows based on your business logic and publish them. Any calls going through this flow will have the value of the variable <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome</span> set to <strong class="ph b">Abandoned</strong>, <strong class="ph b">Handled</strong>, <strong class="ph b">Escalated</strong> or <strong class="ph b">Errored</strong>, depending on the path the call takes. </p>
        </td></tr>
      </tbody></table></div></article></div>
  <div><article id="concept-template_23fb6bf7-93d0-4982-a3c4-ee4d5d225b01" class="topic concept "><h3>Create custom visualizations </h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      <p class="p">You can create custom reports for AI agent call records and AI agent outcome distribution in
      Analyzer. </p>
    </div><div><article id="task-template_d96eff43-5b5b-495c-82ee-870e19b2292b" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h4>Create AI Agent Call Records visualization</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="" /><table class="stepTable" id="steps_qvd_yvk_g2c" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Download the <strong class="ph b">AI Agent Call Records.json</strong> file from   <a data-scope="external" href="https://github.com/WebexSamples/webex-contact-center-api-samples/blob/main/Custom%20Reports%20for%20AI%20Agents%20/AI%20Agent%20Call%20Records.json" target="_blank" title="">AI Agent Call Records</a>.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Log in to Analyzer.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id=""> On the Home page, click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Visualization</span> icon in Analyzer. </p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Import</span>.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Browse </span>to select the file (.json format) to be imported.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Import</span> to import the <strong class="ph b">AI Agent Call Records.json</strong> file.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489223.png" alt="Webex Contact Center Analyzer with import templates window opened" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489223.png" width="" height="" /></p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">7</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Edit </span>to modify the imported Visualization.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489224.png" alt="Webex contact center visualizations builder with AI Agent Call Records edit option selected" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489224.png" width="" height="" /></p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">8</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click on <span class="ph uicontrol">Edit Filters</span> for <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome.</span><image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489225.png" alt="Webex contact center with AI Agents page displayed" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489225.png" width="" height="" /></p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">9</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">is in</span> radio button and add the values <span class="ph uicontrol">ABANDONED</span>, <span class="ph uicontrol">ESCALATED</span>, <span class="ph uicontrol">ERRORED</span>, <span class="ph uicontrol">HANDLED</span>.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489226.png" alt="Webex Contact Center Analyzer visualizations page with New filters window expanded" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489226.png" width="" height="" /></p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">10</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Save and initiate a few test calls.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">11</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Run the visualization to view the results.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489227.png" alt="AI Agents table displaying nine columns of agent-related information" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489227.png" width="" height="" /></p>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table></div></article></div><div><article id="task-template_c0ce4cb2-9244-422c-92a0-06e2919095fc" class="topic task no_summary_steps"><h4>Create AI Agent Outcome Distribution visualization</h4><div id="" class="body taskbody"><section class="section context" id="" /><table class="stepTable" id="" border="0"><tbody>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">1</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Download the <strong class="ph b">AI Agent Outcome Distribution.json</strong> file from  <a data-scope="external" href="https://github.com/WebexSamples/webex-contact-center-api-samples/blob/main/Custom%20Reports%20for%20AI%20Agents%20/AI%20Agent%20Outcome%20Distribution.json" target="_blank" title="">AI Agent Outcome Distribution</a>.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">2</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Log in to Analyzer.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">3</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id=""> On the home page, click the <span class="ph uicontrol">Visualization</span> icon in Analyzer.
        </p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">4</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Import</span>.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">5</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Browse </span> to choose the file (in JSON format) to be
          imported.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">6</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Import</span> to import the <strong class="ph b">AI Agent Outcome Distribution.json</strong> file.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">7</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click <span class="ph uicontrol">Edit </span> to modify the imported Visualization.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">8</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click on <span class="ph uicontrol">Edit Filters</span> for <span class="ph uicontrol">CustomAIAgentInteractionOutcome.</span></p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">9</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Click the <span class="ph uicontrol">is in</span> radio button and add the values <span class="ph uicontrol">ABANDONED</span>, <span class="ph uicontrol">ESCALATED</span>, <span class="ph uicontrol">ERRORED</span>, <span class="ph uicontrol">HANDLED</span>.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">10</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Save and initiate a few test calls.</p>
          </td></tr>
          <tr class="li step" id=""><td align="center" valign="middle" class="ordered-number">11</td><td align="left" valign="top" border="0">
            <p class="ph cmd" id="">Run the visualization to view the results.<image src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489228.png" alt="Visualization view screenshot is added" data-src="https://cisco-api.ingeniuxondemand.com/DITA/content/en/us/td/i/400001-500000/480001-490000/489001-490000/489228.png" width="" height="" /></p>
          </td></tr>
        </tbody></table></div></article></div></article></div>
</article>
  </main>
</div>
<div id="content" class="article-content">
  <main role="main">
    <article role="article">
      <nav>
        <ul class="simple">
          <li class="olchildlink">
            <a href="#concept-template_e2b4da7c-fb4c-4354-bf5e-92da5a0748e0">Understand AI transparency for AI agents</a>
          </li>
          <li class="olchildlink">
            <a href="#reference-template_974fb480-6259-4175-abe7-a660e2cc9868">
      AI development, data privacy, security, and safety
    </a>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </nav>
  
  <div><article id="concept-template_e2b4da7c-fb4c-4354-bf5e-92da5a0748e0" class="topic concept "><h3>Understand AI transparency for AI agents</h3><div id="" class="body conbody">
      
      <p class="p">Many regions require organizations to notify users when providing AI services, for example,
         <a data-scope="external" href="https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/" target="_blank" title="">The EU
        Artificial Intelligence Act</a> in Europe. AI transparency lets you tell customers when
      they are interacting with an AI agent before the conversation continues. This disclosure
      applies for both scripted and autonomous AI agents, works across supported voice and digital
      channels, and can be previewed with the existing welcome experience in the AI Agent Studio
      user interface.</p>
      <section id="" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">How AI transparency works</h4>
      <p class="p">Use the <span class="ph uicontrol">AI transparency</span> settings in the agent profile to control the
        customer-facing disclosure message.</p>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">Autonomous AI agents use the transparency note like a welcome message setting. For more
          information, see  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/preview/ncs9r37/Webex-AI-Agent-Studio-Administration-guide#task-template_5416be2f-b95e-4b80-bebc-3fa8201414bf" target="_blank" title="">Update autonomous AI agent profile</a>.</li><li class="li">Scripted AI agents let you configure language-specific transparency notes and fall back
          to the default note when a language-specific message is unavailable. For more information,
          see  <a data-scope="external" href="https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/preview/ncs9r37/Webex-AI-Agent-Studio-Administration-guide#task-template_c7edf167-b532-4222-b464-d54ad1d8b893" target="_blank" title="">Update scripted AI agent profile</a>.</li></ul>
      <p class="p">
        <ul class="ul"><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">In European regions</strong>: This feature is enabled by default. A transparency message
            will play or appear (depending on the channel) for all agent types. To disable this
            feature, you must acknowledge the risks and add audit comments before opting out.</li><li class="li"><strong class="ph b">In all other regions</strong>: You can choose whether to enable the feature and
            configure the message as needed. Cisco recommends enabling AI transparency as a best
            practice to help ensure end users are informed when interacting with AI agents.</li></ul>
      </p>
    </section>
      <section id="" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">Channel behavior</h4>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">For voice interactions, the transparency note plays before the welcome message and
          callers cannot interrupt it.</li><li class="li">For digital interactions, the transparency note is added to the first AI-generated
          response in the session.</li></ul>
    </section>
      <section id="" class="section">
      <h4 class="title sectiontitle">What to review before you publish</h4>
      <ul class="ul"><li class="li">Review the default transparency message ensuring that the wording clearly identifies AI
          interaction.</li><li class="li">Limit it to 200 characters.</li><li class="li">Make sure the message matches your organization's legal and brand guidance.</li><li class="li">Preview the disclosure in each supported channel and language.</li><li class="li">If you turn off AI transparency, acknowledge the warning and provide a reason.</li><li class="li">Make sure to have AI disclosure language, such as "I am an AI assistant", "I am an AI
          agent" as a prefix for your branding changes.</li></ul>
    </section>
    </div></article></div>
  <div><article id="reference-template_974fb480-6259-4175-abe7-a660e2cc9868" class="topic reference "><h3>
      <strong class="ph b">AI development, data privacy, security, and safety</strong>
    </h3><div id="" class="body refbody">
      <section id="" class="section">
        <strong class="ph b">AI Product Development</strong>
        <p class="p">For every AI-powered feature, we undergo an AI Impact
        Assessment against our  <a data-scope="external" href="https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en_us/about/doing_business/trust-center/docs/cisco-responsible-artificial-intelligence-principles.pdf?CCID=cc000742&amp;DTID=odicdc000016" target="_blank" title="">Responsible AI principles</a>, and adhere to the  <a data-scope="external" href="https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en_us/about/doing_business/trust-center/docs/cisco-responsible-artificial-intelligence-framework.pdf" target="_blank" title="">Responsible AI Framework</a>, in addition to existing
        Security, Privacy, and Human Rights by Design processes.</p>
        <strong class="ph b">Privacy and Security</strong>
        <p class="p">We
        don’t retain customer input data after the inference process, and the third-party model
        provider, Microsoft, doesn’t access, monitor, or store Cisco customer data. For more detail
        on feature-specific data retention policies, see <a data-scope="external" href="https://trustportal.cisco.com/c/r/ctp/trust-portal.html?search_keyword=webex%20ai%20agent#/19445370048945010" target="_blank" title=""> Webex AI Agent AI transparency technical note</a> in
        the Cisco Trust Portal.</p>
        <strong class="ph b">Data Sources for Training and Evaluation</strong>
        <p class="p">Our third-party model provider,
        Microsoft doesn't use customer content to improve Azure OpenAI models and doesn’t store or
        retain Cisco customer data in Azure infrastructure.</p>
        <strong class="ph b">Safety and Ethical
        Considerations</strong>
        <p class="p">All generative AI features are prone to errors, so we prioritize
        content safety for AI features by opting in to  <a data-scope="external" href="https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/concepts/content-filter?tabs=warning%2Cpython-new" target="_blank" title="">Content filtering</a>, provided by Azure
        OpenAI.</p>
        <strong class="ph b">Model Evaluation and Performance</strong>
        <p class="p">We prioritize the performance and
        accuracy of AI Assistant by involving humans in the review, testing, and quality assurance
        of the underlying model.</p>
      </section>
